BeanGuru are bookkeepers for Busy Business owners. We love to help business owners manage their books to they can get back to their “Why they run their business”.



Would you like to help business owners get more time back? Do you like knowing you’ve made their job easier by using your amazing bookkeeping skills to do what they don’t have time to do? Are you detail oriented, positive, eager to learn and humble enough to ask questions?



If yes we’d like to invite you to become a valued member of our small but fast growing team.



We service small to medium businesses across Australia for their bookkeeping needs. We are a professionally run, highly systemised, Xero focused business that values our clients and our tea
mbers like family. And we love attention to detail.



Note you are working as a full time direct tea
mber with Bean Guru employed by us through our Philippines representative and not via an agency or offshoring middle person.





*** We are looking for a Bookkeeper who has worked with Australian Bookkeeping and GST as well as done client communication. ***



*** On your first day with us you’ll have at least 3+ years experience working with Australian bookkeeping operations including GST, IAS and BAS. ***



You’ll also already have extensive experience in XERO as well as the core aspects of bookkeeping:

- AR/AP - invoicing, statements, reconciliation, batch payments etc

- Bank and Ledger Reconciliations

- Data entry and transaction processing

- Basic reporting



Experience in payroll and superannuation would be highly regarded:



It also important that you have excellent spoken and written English, are a clear communicator, eager to learn/grow your skills and open to seeking help when needed.



As a finance professional you will have a comfortable and productive work environment, excellent internet access that supports video calling.



We look forward to meeting you. If you put the number 42 in your application to us we'll know you have attention to detail.



Benefits and Pay:

- Salary based on experience + many benefits including:

- 13-month pay

- All Paid PH Public Holidays

- Daytime (AU East Coast) work hours with some flexibility on start time

- Full-time EMPLOYMENT

- WORK FROM HOME



***Applicants must be LEGAL to work and currently residing in the Philippines***



Our hiring process will be a little bit different we want to hire great people with the right mindset and fit for our great company culture.



1. **Reply to this ad with your resume and a covering letter telling us why you'd like to work with us and reason for change. Please don't contact us directly**

2. We will contact the short list and have a first interview.

3. We will do a skills test which will take roughly 60-90mins

4. Final interview with our founder Judith.

5. A call to say you made it welcome aboard.

title: B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter
description:
B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter (Remote – Philippines)



Company: All Time Guards Security Services

Location: Remote (Philippines)

Employment Type: Full-Time or Part-Time



About Us



All Time Guards Security Services is a licensed California security company providing professional security guard and mobile patrol services to apartment communities, hotels, shopping centers, HOAs, warehouses, construction sites, office buildings, government facilities, and other commercial properties throughout Southern California.



We are looking for a motivated and experienced Cold Caller / Appointment Setter who is confident speaking with business decision-makers and can help generate qualified sales appointments for our management team.



Responsibilities



* Make outbound cold calls to apartment complexes, property management companies, hotels, HOAs, shopping centers, warehouses, office buildings, construction companies, schools, healthcare facilities, and government organizations.

* Identify the person responsible for security services or vendor selection.

* Build rapport and professionally introduce our company.

* Ask qualifying questions to identify security needs.

* Schedule appointments or discovery calls for our sales team.

* Maintain accurate call notes and update the CRM after every conversation.

* Follow up with prospects when appropriate.

* Meet daily call and appointment-setting goals.



Requirements



* Excellent spoken and written English.

* Neutral or clear English accent.

* At least 1 year of B2B cold calling or appointment-setting experience.

* Comfortable speaking with business owners, property managers, and executives.

* Strong communication and objection-handling skills.

* Self-motivated, organized, and dependable.

* Stable high-speed internet connection.

* Quiet home office with a quality USB headset.

* Experience using dialers such as VICIdial, GoHighLevel, RingCentral, Five9, or similar is preferred.

* Experience with CRM software is a plus.



Performance Expectations



* 150–250 outbound calls per day.

* Generate qualified appointments with decision-makers.

* Maintain detailed and accurate CRM notes.

* Consistently meet or exceed weekly appointment goals.



Compensation



* Competitive hourly pay based on experience.

* Performance bonuses for qualified appointments and closed accounts.

* Long-term opportunity with room for advancement as our company grows.



Earn bonuses for every qualified appointment and additional bonuses for contracts that close. Top performers can significantly increase their monthly earnings.



To Apply



Please send:



* Your resume.

* A 1–2 minute voice recording introducing yourself.





If you’re confident, persistent, and enjoy speaking with business professionals, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and help grow one of Southern California’s fastest-growing security companies.

EasyMate is built for non-technical business owners who do not have large teams, expensive software systems, or technical expertise. EasyMate configures the right AI assistants and solutions for SMB owners based on their business problems. They don't have to learn AI.



The Role

We are looking for a Growth Marketing Specialist to own the entire demand side of the business -  everything from "who do we target" to "they paid." You are a hands-on data-driven operator, not a manager or strategist: you'll personally build the lists, send the
s, work the replies, and optimize the funnel. 

Working directly with the founder and GTM engineers, you will execute and optimize the campaigns that drive our growth. You’ll be expected to move fast, test aggressively, and iterate based on what the data tells us. No corporate fluff, just pure growth.



What You'll Own

- Targeting: Build and qualify prospect lists that fit our ICP (revenue-generating small-to-medium businesses). Experienced with tools like Clay, Apollo, LinkedIn, niche data sources and SEMrush/SpyFu.

- Outbound Mastery: Launch and manage cold
 sequences with "invisible" personalization copy so natural that a U.S. lead would never guess it was automated. Run the cold
 campaign end to end - write and test the messaging, manage sending domains/inboxes and deliverability (SPF/DKIM/DMARC, warmup, volume).

- Follow-up & conversion: Work every reply fast, send the checkout link, remove friction, get them to paid.

- Growth Lab: Run continuous A/B tests on subject lines, hooks, and CTAs to drive conversions.

- Funnel Optimization: Analyze campaign performance via GA4 and outbound dashboards to identify and fix leaks in the funnel. Track the full funnel (demos sent ? clicked ? replied ? paid), report weekly, and double down on what converts.

- Collaborative Iteration: Work with the founder and GTM engineer to update landing pages and funnels based on real-time market feedback.

- Channel testing: Once outbound works, run cheap tests on the next channels (communities, partnerships, referral).



What We're Looking For

Must-haves

- Experience: 2 - 4 years in digital marketing, growth hacking and lead generation (SaaS experience is a major plus).

- Tool Stack: Hands-on proficiency with 
, Apollo, Lemlist, Instantly, Clay, GA4, SemRush/SpyFu

- The "Invisible English" Factor: Your written English must be flawless. You can write persuasive, high-converting copy for a U.S. executive audience without it sounding "robotic" or "foreign."

- Data Literacy: You live in the metrics. You understand CAC, LTV, and conversion rates, and you know how to move them.

- Schedule: Based in Jakarta with reliable high-speed internet. You must be comfortable with a 4-hour overlap with U.S. Pacific Time (typical evening/night hours in Asia).

- Grit: You thrive in a fast-paced startup environment where you are expected to ship multiple experiments weekly.

- Full-time: This is a demanding position, and you need to dedicate 100% of your time to this role



Nice-to-haves

- Experience selling self-serve to prosumers/SMBs (coaches, home-services, creators, consultants, event planners, therapists etc).

- A track record of getting a startup its first 100 paying customers.

- Outbound automation experience



Who thrives here

- You can move fast without waiting for a perfect brief

- You think in systems, not one-off tasks

- You are data-driven and yet able to come up with creative experiments

- You're comfortable being the only person owning this function for now



Why Join EasyMate

- Ground-floor opportunity to define the growth playbook for an emerging AI product category

- Direct impact — your work will be one of our primary growth levers

- Async-friendly, remote team

- Work on a product that's genuinely novel (and fun to explain)

- Mentorship: Direct exposure to scaling an AI startup alongside the founder.

- Freedom: 100% remote work with a high-trust, results-only culture.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
About Exponential Oaks



Exponential Oaks is a web development and digital marketing agency specializing in websites, SEO, and paid ads for health & wellness businesses — med spas, wellness centers, chiropractic and functional health practices, and beauty/aesthetics brands. We're currently building out our presence across Georgia, starting in the Coweta, Fayette, and South Fulton County region before expanding statewide.



Our current client portfolio includes health & wellness brands like CMI Health, Aura Health, Function Health, and Total Esthetics, alongside select projects in other industries. We build fast, modern, high-performing websites (React, Next.js, Vercel) and pair them with real marketing systems — not just a pretty site with no way to generate leads.



We're a small, fast-moving team (founder + software engineer currently), looking to bring on specialists who can own their channel end-to-end and grow with us as we scale.



About the role



Note: the Requirements section below is what actually matters for applying — everything under "Nice to have" and "Other marketing channels" is upside, not a checklist you need to fully match. If you meet the core requirements, apply even if you don't have every extra skill listed.



You'll own both SEO and paid advertising for our health & wellness clients and our own agency growth — Google Business Profile, technical/local SEO, Google Local Services Ads, Search Ads, and Meta 
/Instagram) Ads. This is a combined role for someone comfortable working across both channels rather than specializing deeply in one. You'll be executing against a documented playbook and existing tracking setup, not building strategy from scratch.



Responsibilities



SEO (roughly 50%)



Manage and optimize Google Business Profiles (categories, service areas, posts, photos, Q&A)

Keyword research and on-page SEO for health & wellness search terms

Technical SEO maintenance: meta titles/descriptions, Open Graph tags, sitemap.xml, 
 markup

Local SEO strategy across Georgia service areas, starting hyper-local (Coweta/Fayette/South Fulton)

Review generation strategy and execution





Paid Ads (roughly 50%)



Set up and manage Google Local Services Ads (LSA) for eligible clients

Build and manage Google Search and Meta 
/Instagram) ad campaigns

Monitor and optimize budgets, bids, and targeting based on conversion data

Work with existing case-study assets (Total Esthetics, CMI Health, Aura Health, Function Health) to build ad creative

Maintain and troubleshoot conversion tracking (GA4, Google Ads tag, Meta Pixel)





Both



Combined monthly reporting — rankings, traffic, GBP engagement, ad performance, and cost-per-lead in one view





Requirements



Experience with both SEO and paid ads for local/small businesses — doesn't need to be deep expertise in each, but real hands-on exposure to both

Familiarity with Google Business Profile, Google Ads/LSA, and Meta Ads Manager

Comfortable with GA4 and basic conversion tracking concepts

Strong written and spoken English

Comfortable working async, self-directed, against documented SOPs and KPIs

Health & wellness, med spa, or beauty industry experience a plus





Nice to have / Extra skills



Basic copywriting — ad copy, GBP posts, landing page headlines/CTAs

Familiarity with HubSpot (forms, workflows, contact/deal pipeline) — we use it for lead tracking

Basic
 marketing experience (Mailchimp or similar) — nurture sequences, review request campaigns

Canva or basic graphic design — ad creative, GBP photo posts

Social media posting/scheduling experience (Instagram/Facebook business pages)

Review management — responding to and encouraging Google/Facebook reviews

Basic competitor research — identifying what's working for other local health & wellness businesses

Comfortable in Google Sheets/Excel for reporting and tracking

Google Tag Manager — more robust tracking setup than a basic pixel install, useful as we add more conversion events

Awareness of healthcare/medical advertising policies (Google and Meta both restrict certain health-related ad targeting and claims) — relevant given clients like CMI Health and Function Health

Basic conversion rate optimization (CRO) / A/B testing concepts — headline, CTA, and landing page testing

Local citation/directory management (Yelp, Healthgrades, Vagaro, and other wellness-specific directories beyond Google)

Short-form video basics (Reels/TikTok-style content) — high-performing format for beauty/wellness before-and-after and behind-the-scenes content

Landing page builder experience (Unbounce, Webflow, or similar) — helpful even though our core sites are custom-built

Experience managing multiple client accounts/campaigns simultaneously without mixing up budgets or reporting

AI-assisted content creation (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) for scaling ad copy, GBP posts, and blog content across multiple clients without sacrificing quality

Familiarity with Google's AI-driven campaign types (Performance Max) — increasingly relevant as manual campaign management becomes less effective

No-code automation tools (Zapier, Make) — ability to connect our lead capture, CRM, and
 systems into repeatable workflows without needing a developer for every change

Looker Studio (or similar) for building reusable, scalable reporting dashboards as we add more clients

Awareness of AI/generative search behavior (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT search) and how it's changing traditional SEO — sometimes called answer engine optimization or generative engine optimization

Automated review request tools (SMS/email-triggered) — helps the review-generation responsibility scale without manual outreach per client





Other marketing channels/disciplines that would benefit us



Beyond core SEO and paid search/social, exposure to any of these is a plus — they're channels we may expand into as we scale:





SMS marketing — appointment reminders, promotions, and review requests; a strong fit for spa/wellness booking behavior

Content marketing/blogging — educational content around treatments and services, supports both SEO and patient/client trust

TikTok Ads — beauty and wellness content performs especially well here; a natural extension of the short-form video skill already listed

YouTube/video ads — longer-form before-and-after, testimonial, or educational content

Geofencing/location-based mobile ads — targeting nearby mobile users, useful for hyper-local service areas

Local partnership/referral marketing — cross-promotion with adjacent local businesses (gyms, salons, wellness-adjacent retailers)

Influencer/micro-influencer marketing — local wellness and beauty influencers for authentic reach

Marketplace/directory advertising — Yelp Ads, Nextdoor Ads, beyond organic directory listings

PR/local media outreach — local press, community features, and earned media

Event or pop-up marketing — open houses, community events tied to client locations

title: Very Organized Executive Assistant, Brand & Social Media heavy Remote | USA EST hours
description:
The application instructions at the bottom are specific. Only apply if you have direct experience as an assistant and with the applications below.



About us



We are a skincare brand serving women with acne-prone, barrier-compromised skin. We've been doing this for over fifteen years long before holistic skincare was a category anyone was chasing. Our clients don't find us through ads. They find us because someone they trust told them we were the ones who finally listened.



We're entering a new chapter. Our founder is stepping forward publicly as the lead content creator for the brand and the work ahead is connecting the woman who built this to the women it was built for.



We are a high-performance team. The pace is real and the standards are high but so is the care. We communicate directly, we don't let people struggle in silence, and we take genuine pride in what leaves our hands.



What this role is



We're hiring an assistant with strong social media skills — not a social media manager. The distinction matters, so here it is plainly:



A social media manager owns a channel. This role owns the founder's throughput. Content is a large part of the work, but it isn't the whole of it. You're the person who takes what's in her head at 9am and has it live, correct, and on-brand by end of day.  Must be an independent thinker.



Skill is required. Execution is the differentiator.



You will work in close, daily contact with the founder. Direction will change and sometimes mid-task. That isn't disorganization; it's what building a public brand looks like from the inside. The right person finds that energizing. The wrong person finds it exhausting, and we'd rather you know that now.  We are growing the brand not maintaining it.  This is an exciting role for someone who loves to get things done.



What you'll own



Execution and operations



- A high daily task load, consistently cleared — not carried forward

- Asana and Notion as living systems: every task updated as it moves, with enough written context that the founder never has to ask where something stands

- End-of-day reports, every day, without being asked. Done / in progress / blocked / needs a decision from the founder.

- Rapid pivots as priorities shift, with the judgment to flag when a pivot creates a conflict rather than silently dropping the previous thing



Content and brand



- Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube are our main platforms (this may expand) You will be responsible for calendar planning, scheduling, publishing

- Presenting plan to founder weekly during meetings

- Short-form video editing with strong hooks and retention-aware pacing

- Feminine, editorial-leaning graphics with a cohesive aesthetic across platforms

- Captions in the founder's voice, not a generic brand voice

- Repurposing single pieces of content into multiple formats across channels

- Community management — warm, professional, on-brand replies to comments and DMs

- Basic performance tracking: what worked, what didn't, what you'd do differently



Who we're looking for



- Highly adaptable. Change is the job. You reorganize around it without needing to be settled first.

- A strong communicator. You over-communicate rather than going quiet. Silence is the only real failure mode here.

- Genuinely organized. Nothing falls through, and nothing lives only in your head.

- Fast and finished. You'd rather ship something 90% right today and refine it than sit on something 100% right next week.

- Available USA EST hours. This is non-negotiable — the role requires real-time responsiveness.

- An eye for feminine luxury. Soft but powerful. Editorial. Elevated without being cold.

- An understanding of storytelling.

- Comfortable with: CapCut Pro, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere or Final Cut a plus)



Bonus if you



- Have worked with beauty, skincare, wellness, or feminine lifestyle brands

- Understand emotional storytelling and how women actually make skincare decisions

- Have supported a founder through a public-facing launch or rebrand



How to apply



 [ADDRESS] with the subject line: IN LOVE WITH SKINCARE



Include:



1. Your resume and experience.

2. Your portfolio — reels, TikToks, graphic design, Instagram feeds, video edits for BEAUTY

3. Links to brands you've worked with and before and afters, when you began working and after you left

4. Details on how many hours you have available

5. 3–5 videos you edited that performed well, and your honest read on why they performed





We also would like to know:



6. Something you've achieved in your personal life recently. Anything at all. Tell us why it mattered to you and why

7. A team you've been part of. What was your actual role on it — not your title, your role.

8. Any awards or recognition you've received, and what you're doing with that now.

9. A time direction changed on you mid-task. What did you do?

10. What beauty brands or creators you find visually excellent, and what makes content feel luxurious rather than expensive.



Lastly please confirm you are comfortable with the rate and your availability during EST hours is aligned.



Include the word Glow somewhere so we know you read all of this.



What happens next



We are moving quickly on this and will begin interviews immediately.



Our team has a lot of heart and we only work alongside people who are kind.  We look forward to meeting you.

title: Video Editor for Weekly YouTube + Course Videos — Per-Video Pay, Long-Term (1-2 videos/week)
description:
Hi! I'm Ali, and I run a growing online education/coaching business in the US. I'm looking for a talented, reliable video editor to become my long-term editing partner.



The work (every week, ongoing):

• Fast-cut editing style: tight pacing, remove pauses, filler words, and mistakes — think modern YouTube pacing

• Apply my custom filter/LUT to match my brand look (I'll provide the files and a style guide)

• Cut 2 short vertical clips (Reels/Shorts) from each video

• Videos are published on YouTube, IG and inside my course/membership portal, so quality and consistency matter (you can check out my channel here 
 )



What I provide:

• Raw footage via Google Drive (main video files, images for end screens, and B-roll if applicable)

• My music files (I compose the music myself for my videos)

• Example videos showing the exact pacing and look I want

• Clear feedback, fast payment, and steady weekly work



Requirements:

• 2+ years of video editing experience with a portfolio of talking-head / YouTube-style edits

• Strong fast-cut / jump-cut editing skills (show me examples!)

• Confident with color grading and applying LUTs/custom filters

• You can use whatever software you're best in (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut — your choice), as long as the output matches my style and the file type/size is what I request. 

• Reliable internet fast enough to download ~10–30GB of footage per video

• Ability to deliver each video within 3 business days of receiving footage

• Good written English and responsive communication (I'll mostly communicate async)



Pay:

Flat rate per video package (one 15-30 min edited video + 2 shorts), with a budget of $25 or under per package. Before you quote, know this: the footage comes to you PRE-switched between the two camera angles, so there's no multi-cam syncing or angle-cutting from scratch — I edit these videos myself in under 2 hours, and I'm only handing them off to free up my time. 



Tell me your rate per video package in your application. Paid biweekly via Wise, direct to your GCash or bank account in PHP. This is steady, long-term work — 2 videos every week, 8+ packages a month — for the right person. Super excited to find someone to help me with this as I've been doing it for 10 years! 



How to apply (read carefully — this is my first test):

• Start your application with the word PINEAPPLE so I know you read this whole post.

Applications that don't follow these steps will not be considered. I'm excited to find the right person and keep them busy for a long time!

We’re a fast-growing junk removal & light demolition company in Tampa Bay, Florida. We run a tight ship and care a lot about our numbers. We use Jobber, QuickBooks Online, Google Sheets, and AI exports to track performance.



We’re now looking for a full-time Financial Operations & QBO Specialist to own bookkeeping prep, reconciliations, and reporting quality. You will work closely with the owner and our external bookkeeper.



This is not a basic VA role. This is for an experienced bookkeeper / accountant who has managed books for US service businesses before.



Role Overview

Compensation: Starting at $1,000/month USD full-time (40 hrs/week), with room to increase based on performance after 3 months.



You will be responsible for:



Keeping our financial data clean, accurate, and up to date in QuickBooks Online (working with our bookkeeper).

Reconciling Jobber ? QBO ? bank data and AI exports.

Preparing simple, reliable weekly and monthly reports so the owner can make decisions fast.

Helping with payroll prep and other finance-related admin tasks.

This is a full-time role (40 hours/week), long-term. We prefer candidates who want to grow with the company and take on more responsibility over time.



Important: You will prepare and reconcile all numbers, but the owner/bookkeeper will approve all payments, transfers, and final filings.



Responsibilities

Daily / Weekly



Review Jobber / AI exports (jobs, revenue, services) in Google Sheets and flag errors or missing data.

Reconcile job data to QBO where needed (categories, items, customers).

Maintain and update a simple Weekly Performance Sheet:

Jobs completed

Revenue by product line

COGS (from QBO)

Ad spend by channel (we provide the numbers)

Net after ads and basic margin checks

Flag anything that looks off (margin drops, weird spikes, negative items, etc.) and send a short summary.

Monthly



Ensure Jobber invoices / payments are correctly mapped to QBO products & income accounts for our bookkeeper.

Prepare the payroll summary (hours, OT, tips, commissions) in our template (weekly).

Help keep QBO reconciled and ready for financial review.

Provide a short bullet summary of what changed vs last month (good / bad / ugly).

Over time (for the right person), this role can expand into owning bookkeeping end-to-end with our oversight.



Requirements

3+ years bookkeeping experience for US-based businesses.

Strong QuickBooks Online skills (certification preferred).

Experience with at least one field-service or job management tool:

Jobber, Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, or similar (Jobber is a big plus).

Comfortable reading, cleaning, and reconciling exports in Google Sheets.

Stable internet and ability to work a consistent schedule with at least 3–4 hours overlap with US Eastern time (Mon–Fri).

title: Practice Operations Coordinator (Virtual, Full-Time) — US Dermatology Practice
description:
Practice Operations Coordinator (Virtual, Full-Time) — US Dermatology Practice



Full-time | Long-term, dedicated role | Pacific Time hours | $12-15/hour based on experience



We are an established, independent dermatology and skin cancer surgery practice in Southern California. Our physician-owner runs a tight, well-documented operation — written SOPs for every workflow, shared tracking logs, and a small team of long-term virtual staff — and we are hiring a senior-level coordinator to become the operational backbone of that system.



This is not a task-list VA position. We are looking for someone with real US healthcare insurance experience who can monitor, audit, and follow through without being reminded — a person who notices what's slipping before the doctor does.



What you'll own





Daily operations report. Each morning, you'll review our tracking systems (authorization queues, pathology follow-up, compliance calendar) and send the physician a short daily report: what's on track, what's aging, who owns what. This report is the heartbeat of the role.

Compliance calendar. You'll own our deadline calendar (trainings, renewals, audits, regulatory items) — not just watching the reminders, but converting each one into an assigned, tracked task and following it to completion.

Refund adjudication. You'll review credit balances at the ledger level — charges, contractual adjustments, insurance and patient payments — and determine whether each credit is a true overpayment, a posting error, or a payer takeback in waiting. You'll prepare documented refund requests (correct payee, amount, and evidence) for physician approval. (You will not disburse funds — approval and payment stay with the practice.)

Medication prior authorizations. You'll own our low-volume medication PA queue end to end: submission, follow-up, and tracking to approval or appeal, with status visible in your daily report.

Insurance quality audit. You'll spot-check the team's insurance verifications, authorizations, and referrals against our written protocols and payer rules, and flag anything done wrong or not done at all.

Backup coverage. You'll cross-train on our pathology results and authorization workflows so critical queues never depend on a single person.





What we require





3+ years supporting US medical practices in a role involving insurance: verification, prior authorizations, referrals, eligibility, denials, or billing. You should be comfortable explaining the difference between an HMO, a PPO, and a Medicare Advantage plan — and what each means for getting a surgery authorized.

Payment-posting literacy. You can read an EOB/ERA and a patient ledger — charges, contractual adjustments, payments — and explain why an account shows a credit balance. If you have worked payment posting, credit balance resolution, or refunds for a US practice, say so specifically.

Self-directed follow-through. Most of this work is silent. No patient will complain if you skip it — which is exactly why it matters. We need someone who treats an unwatched queue the same as a watched one.

Excellent written English. Your daily report goes directly to the physician.

A stable, long-term seat with a physician-owner who invests in systems and in people. Our virtual tea

Your resume, with US healthcare clients/employers and dates.

title: YouTube Content Production Assistant (Long-Term, Growing Role)
description:
We run a growing network of YouTube channels in the cars and motorcycles niche, producing 100+ videos per month. As the network grows, this role grows with it. You will start with two clearly defined tasks, every working day:



1. Create voiceovers. You will generate the voiceover for each video using our AI voice tool, with our exact settings, and check the audio before delivery: no mispronounced model names, no weird numbers, no glitches. We will teach you the entire process; no audio experience needed.

2. Check scripts. Before a script goes to production, you check it against our written checklist: correct units, correct structure, our formatting rules followed, obvious errors flagged. You do not rewrite anything; you catch what breaks the rules and report it.



What we are looking for: someone precise, consistent and coachable. Both tasks are fully teachable in the first week, and you will be trained directly by our channel manager. What we cannot teach is care: this job is for someone who genuinely notices when something is slightly off.



Experience that is a plus:



Working on YouTube channels or other content production (uploads, editing support, channel operations)

Proofreading, QA, or any job where your role was catching other people's mistakes

AI tools: text-to-speech or voice generation tools, ChatGPT, Claude or others

Knowledge of cars or motorcycles (you will spot a mispronounced model name much faster)

Remote VA experience with daily deliverables for one long-term client



You are a fit if:



You are obsessively detail-oriented. A mispronounced bike name in a finished voiceover would genuinely bother you

You are consistent: work every working day, communicate when something changes, never just disappear

You read English carefully (our scripts are English, US market)

You follow written instructions exactly, every time

You want stable, long-term work with one team



The offer:



Part-time to start: 20 hours per week, growing into full-time as the network expands

$150/month, paid weekly during the first month

Consistent daily workload

Full training in week one, direct daily contact with our channel manager

Long-term: the network is growing and we promote from inside



To apply, follow these three steps exactly. Applications that miss any step are not read.



1. Type the word SPROCKET in capital letters as the very first line of your application, before anything else. This is how we know you read the full post.

2. Four of our script rules are: all units must be US units (miles, pounds, dollars); scripts never use the em dash character; every video intro must be under 60 words; prices are always exact ranges, never the word "around". Here is a script fragment. Tell me every rule violation you find:

"The Kawasaki Vulcan S weighs 226 kilograms and sells for around four thousand dollars. It is the perfect first cruiser for a returning rider, and the low seat means almost anyone can plant both feet flat at a stoplight."

3. Tell me your available working hours in Amsterdam time, and whether you have other clients.

title: URGENT HIRING: $7/hr Marketing Automation & Funnel Specialist
description:
# URGENT HIRING: Marketing Automation, Funnels & Systems Specialist



**Company:** Residual Marketing

**Position:** Marketing Automation, Funnels & Systems Specialist

**Location:** Remote

**Starting Pay:** **$7 USD per hour**

**Performance Bonus:** **$50 for each complete client system built quickly, accurately, tested, documented, and approved**

**Schedule:** Part-time to start

**Growth Opportunity:** Full-time position and pay increase after 30–60 days based on performance and workload

**Start Date:** Immediately



## About the Role



Residual Marketing is urgently hiring a skilled **Marketing Automation, Funnels & Systems Specialist** to build complete automated systems for our agency and every new company we sign as a client.



We are not looking for someone who only knows how to build landing pages, copy workflows, or wait for step-by-step instructions.



We need someone who understands:



* Marketing

* Sales funnels

* Customer journeys

* Business operations

* Lead generation

* Appointment setting

* Follow-up

* Client onboarding

* Project fulfillment

* Automation strategy



The right person must be able to study how a business operates, understand how it makes money, identify gaps in the process, recommend improvements, and build a complete system that helps the company run more efficiently.



We want someone who can bring ideas, suggest better solutions, and add real value.



## Main Systems You Will Use



You will primarily work inside:



* **GoHighLevel**

* **Slack**

* **Timeliner**



Strong GoHighLevel experience is required.



Timeliner is a simple system used for client projects, timelines, deliverables, and team responsibilities. Experience with Timeliner is not required because training will be provided, but you must be able to learn new software quickly.



## Main Goal of the Position



For every company that signs with Residual Marketing, your job will be to help us organize and automate its complete customer journey.



This may include:



**Lead Generation ? Lead Capture ? Lead Assignment ? Follow-Up ? Qualification ? Appointment Booking ? Sales ? Contracts ? Payments ? Onboarding ? Fulfillment ? Client Communication ? Reporting**



You will also help maintain, improve, and troubleshoot Residual Marketing’s internal systems.



## Responsibilities



* Learn how each client’s business operates

* Understand the client’s services, customers, sales process, and marketing goals

* Identify missing steps, weak points, bottlenecks, and automation opportunities

* Recommend improvements before and during the build

* Build landing pages, funnels, forms, surveys, and calendars

* Create and organize GoHighLevel pipelines

* Build complete GoHighLevel workflows from beginning to end

* Connect Meta Lead Ads and other lead sources to GoHighLevel

* Create contact and opportunity records while preventing duplicates

* Set up round-robin and assigned-user lead distribution

* Build SMS and
 follow-up sequences

* Build staff and AI lead-qualification workflows

* Create appointment booking, confirmation, reminder, rescheduling, and no-show automations

* Build long-term follow-up and nurture campaigns

* Create internal tasks and staff notifications

* Connect GoHighLevel updates to Slack

* Automate contract, payment, and onboarding processes

* Create client projects, timelines, tasks, and deliverables inside Timeliner

* Build handoffs between sales, onboarding, and fulfillment

* Automate client updates and project-status communication

* Create custom fields, tags, triggers, conditions, workflow goals, and smart lists

* Test every automation before it is published

* Troubleshoot broken workflows and integration problems

* Prevent duplicate contacts, opportunities, tasks, alerts, and messages

* Record short training videos explaining completed systems

* Document every important workflow and process

* Maintain and improve systems after launch



## Marketing and Business Knowledge



This is not only a technical role.



You must understand how marketing and business systems work.



You should understand concepts such as:



* Lead generation

* Sales funnels

* Customer journeys

* Offers

* Calls to action

* Lead qualification

* Appointment setting

* Follow-up

* Conversion rates

* Lead nurturing

* Customer retention

* Upselling

* Pipeline management

* Paid advertising

* Client onboarding

* Project fulfillment



We want someone who can review a business and say things like:



* “This step is missing.”

* “Leads may be falling through the cracks here.”

* “This follow-up should happen sooner.”

* “The sales team needs an alert at this point.”

* “This automation could improve the client experience.”

* “This message could increase appointment attendance.”

* “This process can be simplified.”

* “This system could help the company close more business.”



You should not need every small detail explained to you.



You must be able to ask good questions, understand the goal, recommend solutions, and take ownership of the system.



## Example of a Complete Client System



For a service-business client, you may be responsible for building:



1. Landing page and lead form

2. Lead entry into GoHighLevel

3. Contact creation and duplicate prevention

4. Opportunity creation

5. Lead assignment

6. Immediate staff and Slack notifications

7. SMS and
 follow-up

8. Staff or AI qualification

9. Appointment booking

10. Appointment confirmations and reminders

11. No-show follow-up

12. Opportunity pipeline movement

13. Contract follow-up

14. Payment automation

15. Client onboarding

16. Timeliner project creation

17. Team task assignment

18. Deliverable tracking

19. Client approvals

20. Project updates and reporting



The final system must be organized, tested, easy to understand, and easy for the client and internal team to use.



## Required Qualifications



* Strong GoHighLevel experience

* Experience building complete automation systems

* Experience building funnels and landing pages

* Strong understanding of marketing and sales funnels

* Knowledge of CRM pipelines and opportunities

* Experience with SMS and
 automations

* Experience with appointment-booking workflows

* Experience with Slack notifications or integrations

* Ability to understand how a business operates

* Ability to suggest improvements and add value

* Strong troubleshooting and testing skills

* Excellent attention to detail

* Strong written communication

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to meet deadlines

* Reliable internet connection

* Consistent availability

* Ability to begin immediately



## Preferred Experience



* Marketing agency experience

* Meta Lead Ads integrations

* Stripe or payment automations

* GoHighLevel Voice AI

* AI calling or lead-qualification systems

* Zapier, Make, APIs, or webhooks

* Client onboarding systems

* Fulfillment and project-management systems

* Creating SOPs and training videos

* Managing multiple client accounts



## Compensation



The starting rate is:



**$7 USD per hour**



You can also earn:



**A $50 performance bonus for each complete client system that is built quickly, accurately, fully tested, documented, and approved.**



The $50 bonus is earned when:



* The full agreed-upon system is complete

* All required workflows are working correctly

* The system has been tested from beginning to end

* Duplicate contacts, opportunities, tasks, and messages are prevented

* Slack notifications are working

* Timeliner is properly organized

* Documentation or training videos are completed

* The project is delivered on time

* The system is approved by Residual Marketing



Speed is important, but fast work must also be accurate, complete, organized, and fully tested.



Incomplete or rushed systems will not qualify for the bonus.



## Full-Time Growth Opportunity



This position will begin part-time at **$7 USD per hour**.



After the first **30 to 60 days**, you may be promoted to a **full-time, long-term position with a pay increase**.



The decision will be based on:



* Quality and accuracy of work

* Speed of completion

* Reliability

* Communication

* GoHighLevel knowledge

* Ability to understand each client’s business

* Ability to suggest improvements

* Ability to work without constant supervision

* Successful testing and documentation

* Client workload

* Overall value added to the company



Someone who consistently completes high-quality systems, communicates well, meets deadlines, and adds value will have a strong opportunity to become a full-time member of the team.



The $50 performance bonus may continue to be available after moving into the full-time position.



## What Success Looks Like



You will be successful in this role when:



* You understand the business before building

* You ask the right questions

* You recommend improvements instead of only following instructions

* Every client receives a complete and organized system

* Leads enter the correct pipeline

* Leads are assigned to the correct tea
mber

* Staff receives immediate Slack alerts

* Follow-up messages are sent correctly

* Appointments are booked and properly reminded

* No-shows enter the correct follow-up process

* Payments trigger onboarding

* Client projects are correctly created in Timeliner

* Sales, onboarding, and fulfillment stay connected

* No leads fall through the cracks

* Workflows do not create duplicates

* Systems are fully tested before launch

* Documentation is clear

* Problems are identified and fixed quickly

* Your work improves efficiency, conversions, and client experience



## Paid Test Project



Selected applicants may be asked to complete a paid test project.



The test may include:



* Reviewing an existing GoHighLevel workflow

* Identifying missing or incorrect steps

* Recommending improvements

* Fixing one automation

* Connecting a Slack notification

* Organizing part of the client process in Timeliner

* Testing the automation from beginning to end

* Recording a short video explaining the completed work



## Application Questions



Please answer every question:



1. How many years of GoHighLevel experience do you have?

2. Have you built a complete lead-to-onboarding system before?

3. What types of businesses have you built systems for?

4. How do you learn and understand a client’s business before building?

5. How do you identify problems in a marketing or sales process?

6. Can you provide examples or screen recordings of systems you have built?

7. Have you worked with Slack integrations?

8. Have you worked with Meta Lead Ads?

9. Have you worked with Stripe, Zapier, Make, APIs, or webhooks?

10. How do you prevent duplicate contacts, opportunities, and messages?

11. How do you test a workflow before launching it?

12. Are you comfortable suggesting better solutions instead of only following instructions?

13. How many hours are you available each week?

14. What time zone do you work in?

15. What is the earliest date you can start?



## How to Apply



Please send:



* Your full name

* Your location and time zone

* Your GoHighLevel experience

* Your marketing and funnel experience

* Examples or screen recordings of previous work

* Your weekly availability

* Your earliest start date

* A short explanation of how you would automate a company from new lead to onboarding and fulfillment

* One example of how you improved a business process instead of only following the original instructions



## Important



**We are hiring immediately.**



Do not apply if you only know how to design landing pages or copy basic workflows.



We are looking for someone who understands **marketing, automation, customer journeys, sales systems, and business operations**.



The right person must be able to understand the company, recommend better solutions, build the complete system, test it, document it, and continue improving it.

description:
WEDDING PLANNING ASSISTANT (EXECUTOR & AUDITOR)

Ruban Bleu Weddings & Events



MUST HAVE WEDDING EXPERIENCE. THIS IS NON-NEGOTIABLE.

===============================================



Location: Remote

Hours: 15-20 hours per week

Pay: $6-8 PER HOUR depending on experience

Type: Independent contractor



===============================================



ABOUT RUBAN BLEU WEDDINGS & EVENTS



Ruban Bleu is a wedding and events planning company serving couples across the Dallas-Fort Worth area. We specialize in culturally inclusive celebrations, including Indian and South Asian, Nigerian, Ethiopian, East Asian, Mexican and Latin, Jewish, Middle Eastern, and African American weddings, along with LGBTQ+ weddings, destination weddings, and themed celebrations.



Our mission is to make wedding planning smooth, organized, and stress-free for couples who want a beautifully planned wedding without the luxury price tag.



===============================================



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for a Wedding Planning Assistant to serve as our Executor and Auditor. This is the person who owns our project management system as the official record of every wedding, keeps client communication running on schedule, and verifies that the work our contracts promise is actually getting done.



Our operating principle is simple: every task has a doer, a system of record, and a verifier. You are the verifier. "I did it" is a claim. A logged action, a confirmation in hand, or a documented client notification is proof, and only proof closes a task.

title: Shopify App Support Specialist (Live Chat)
description:
We are a small fully remote team that builds and maintains multiple Shopify apps for store owners worldwide. Payments, shipping, discounts, checkout customization, subscriptions, and related tools.



We are not a big corporation. No call-center script. No canned corporate tone. We talk to merchants like real people, short and clear and helpful.



Our support team is small and the load has been too heavy for too long. We are hiring a third person to share coverage properly and make the schedule sustainable.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will handle live chat for Shopify merchants using our apps.



Day to day:



Answer setup and troubleshooting questions

Read screenshots, ask clarifying questions, guide step by step

Sometimes configure rules or settings for a merchant when they are stuck

Explain honestly when something is not possible

Reply in the merchant's language when you can. English is the default

WHAT TYPICAL WORK LOOKS LIKE



Many conversations start simple: merchant opens chat, you ask how you can help.



Then it gets specific. Country-based payment rules. Shipping rate setup. Discount logic not applying. Checkout behavior on certain plans. Billing or uninstall questions. Plan limits. Screenshots back and forth until it is fixed or clearly explained.



Most threads are short to medium length. Some are quick. Some take longer when the merchant is stuck or the store setup is unusual.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Must have:

- Excellent written English. Clear, friendly, natural. Not stiff or robotic

- Stable internet, reliable computer, workable home setup

- Comfortable with live chat. Think while typing, stay calm with frustrated merchants

- Honest and direct. You say when something cannot be done instead of guessing

- Willing to learn Shopify admin: payments, shipping, checkout, billing, plans

- Self-starter on a small team



Big plus:

- Prior Shopify experience as merchant, VA, support, or agency staff

- SaaS or app support experience



Not a fit if:

- You only want rigid scripts

- You avoid technical questions

- You need a large corporate structure to function



SCHEDULE



Full-time, remote.



We are moving to shared coverage so shifts are reasonable and sustainable. Expect roughly 8-hour shifts once the team is fully staffed. Exact rotation will be agreed with the team.



Merchants are global, so some weekend or evening coverage may be part of the rotation.



Start: as soon as possible, up to in 3-4 weeks.



COMPENSATION



Competitive monthly rate in USD starting from ~80000 PHP (assuming average performance). Discussed with shortlisted candidates based on experience. Payments via WISE or e-wallet, unless otherwise discussed.



HOW TO APPLY



Send:

- Available timezones you can work in (timeframes)

- CV 

- Answers to all five screening questions below. Copy each question and answer under it. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.

- Any additional information you feel is great to share with us



SCREENING QUESTIONS (required)



We use these to filter people who have actually worked with Shopify, not people who guessed or used AI. Be specific. Vague answers get skipped. IMPORTANT: about 90% of candidates were skipped in our previous hiring rounds due to AI generated answers, detected by our systems, or later humans. Do not apply if you don't know what you're doing, you'll be wasting yours and our time. If you really don't know what you're doing and apply using 100% AI generated answers, it will always show up later. 



Question 1: A merchant installs a cash-on-delivery app and says "COD is not showing at checkout." Before you touch anything inside the app, what is the exact click path in Shopify admin to enable Cash on Delivery as a payment method? Write it as steps, like Settings > Payments > ...



Question 2: A COD fee app adds the fee at checkout as a shipping rate, not as a separate line item in the order summary. A merchant asks you to change it to a line item instead. Can a typical COD fee app do that within standard Shopify checkout constraints? Answer yes or no, then explain in 2 to 3 sentences why.



Question 3: A merchant on Shopify Basic wants to install an app that adds a custom banner on the checkout page. Can they use checkout customization apps on Basic? What Shopify plan do they need at minimum, and what Shopify capability unlocks checkout customizations?



Question 4: A merchant wants to hide PayPal for customers in one country but keep it visible in another. Which type of Shopify Function handles this: payment customization, delivery customization, or cart transform? Explain briefly why.



Question 5: A merchant says: "I uninstalled your app but I am still being charged." What do you check first, and what are two common explanations that are not actually a bug in the app?



BONUS (optional): Write your first reply to this merchant message exactly as you would send it in chat:



"Hi, I need help with a payment sorting app. I want cash on delivery first in the list but it stays at the bottom no matter what I do."



Keep it short. Sound human.
salary: starts at ~80000 then up to 250000 PHP

title: Klaviyo Email Marketing Specialist for Shopify Fine Jewelry Brand
description:
# Klaviyo
 Marketing Specialist for Shopify Fine Jewelry Brand



## Position Details



**Type of work:** Part-time / Project-Based

**Hours:** Approximately 10–15 hours per week during the initial setup

**Rate:** $10 USD per hour, depending on experience

**Potential:** Long-term ongoing work after the initial project

**Schedule:** Flexible, with some availability for communication during Israel business hours



## About Us



The Private Room is a family-run fine jewelry boutique based in Tel Aviv, Israel.



We sell fine jewelry, personalized jewelry, Judaica jewelry, diamond pieces and custom-made designs through our Shopify website. Our customers are located in Israel, the United States and other international markets.



We are looking for an experienced **Klaviyo
 Marketing Specialist** to build and organize our complete
 marketing system.



This is not a general virtual-assistant position. We are specifically looking for someone with strong, hands-on experience using **Klaviyo with Shopify e-commerce stores**.



## The Project



Our Shopify store is already connected to Klaviyo, and some basic templates and customer events already exist.



We need someone who can audit the current setup, correct technical issues and build a complete customer lifecycle
 system from signup through repeat purchase and VIP retention.



You will be responsible for both the technical setup and the customer-facing execution.



## Main Responsibilities



### 1. Audit and Technical Setup



* Audit our current Klaviyo account and Shopify integration

* Confirm that all important Shopify events are tracking correctly

* Fix or advise us how to fix product catalog synchronization

* Check Viewed Product, Added to Cart, Checkout Started, Placed Order and Fulfilled Order events

* Correct account settings, including timezone and sending configuration

* Check
 consent, list growth and suppression settings

* Confirm that Shopify and Klaviyo are not sending duplicate abandoned-checkout
s

* Test all dynamic links, product information and checkout recovery links

* Improve
 deliverability and sender-domain setup where necessary



### 2. Build the Core Klaviyo Flows



The initial project should include:



* Welcome Series

* Browse Abandonment

* Added-to-Cart Abandonment

* Abandoned Checkout

* First-Time Customer Post-Purchase

* Returning Customer Post-Purchase

* Order Fulfillment Follow-Up

* Jewelry Care

* Product Review Request

* Cross-Sell and Upsell

* Back-in-Stock

* Win-Back

* VIP Customer

* Sunset and Re-Engagement

* Birthday and Anniversary

* Bespoke Jewelry or Private Appointment Lead Follow-Up



Each flow must include the correct:



* Trigger

* Timing and delays

* Flow filters

* Conditional splits

* Exit conditions

* Smart Sending settings

* Customer segmentation

* Purchase and engagement exclusions



Customers must automatically leave cart, checkout or browse flows once they complete a purchase.



### 3.
 Copywriting and Design



* Write clear, elegant and conversion-focused
 copy

* Maintain a refined, personal and luxury tone

* Avoid aggressive or overly promotional language

* Build mobile-friendly
s inside Klaviyo

* Use our existing brand style and Shopify imagery

* Create clear calls to action

* Use dynamic product images and customer information where appropriate

* Create subject lines and preview text

* Include proper unsubscribe and compliance elements

* Separate marketing
s from transactional order communication



The design should feel like a private fine-jewelry boutique—not a generic dropshipping or discount-store template.



### 4. Segmentation and Personalization



Create useful customer segments, including:



* Subscribers who have never purchased

* First-time customers

* Repeat customers

* VIP and high-value customers

* Engaged subscribers

* Unengaged subscribers

* Customers interested in necklaces, bracelets, rings or personalized jewelry

* High-intent browsers

* Abandoned carts and checkouts

* Bespoke-jewelry leads

* Israeli customers

* International customers

* Customers who purchased Judaica or personalized jewelry



Use conditional splits when new customers, returning customers and high-value customers should receive different communication.



### 5. Welcome Offer and Coupons



* Set up our first-purchase welcome offer

* Confirm that the discount is limited to eligible customers

* Recommend whether we should use a fixed code or unique single-use Shopify discount codes

* Prevent existing customers from repeatedly receiving first-purchase discounts

* Test discount links and checkout behavior



### 6. Testing and Quality Assurance



Before any flow is activated, you must:



* Test every
 on desktop and mobile

* Check all links

* Test personalization variables

* Test dynamic Shopify product information

* Confirm flow filters and conditional splits

* Check that customers stop receiving recovery
s after purchasing

* Review spelling, grammar and formatting

* Send test
s for approval

* Receive our approval before changing any flow to Live



Nothing should be activated without our review and approval.



### 7. Reporting and Documentation



At the end of the project, provide:



* A document listing every flow created

* The purpose and trigger of each flow

* Timing between
s

* Filters and conditional splits used

* A list of segments created

* Any Shopify or Klaviyo issues that still require attention

* Recommendations for future campaigns

* A simple monthly reporting template

* A short screen-recorded walkthrough of the account



## Required Experience



You must have:



* Proven hands-on experience with Klaviyo

* Experience integrating and managing Klaviyo with Shopify

* Experience building complete e-commerce lifecycle flows

* Strong written English

*
 copywriting experience

*
 design and layout experience

* Strong knowledge of segmentation and personalization

* Experience with dynamic Shopify product blocks

* Experience testing flow logic and event data

* Understanding of
 deliverability

* Ability to work independently and communicate clearly



Experience with luxury, jewelry, fashion, beauty or other premium e-commerce brands is highly preferred.



## This Role Is Not Suitable For



Please do not apply if:



* You are primarily a general virtual assistant

* You have only used Mailchimp or Shopify

* You have never built Klaviyo flows yourself

* You rely entirely on generic templates or AI-generated copy

* You cannot provide examples of previous Klaviyo work

* You only design
s but cannot configure triggers, filters and conditional logic

* You only configure flows but cannot write or improve the
 content



## How to Apply



Begin your application with the word **DIAMOND** so we know you have read the complete job description.



Please include all of the following:



1. A short introduction explaining your Klaviyo and Shopify experience

2. Links or screenshots showing at least two Klaviyo flows you personally built

3. An example of an
 you wrote and designed

4. One or two measurable results you achieved, such as flow revenue, click rate, conversion rate or revenue per recipient

5. Your hourly rate

6. Your weekly availability

7. Your estimated time to complete the initial setup

8. A short Loom or video introduction of no more than three minutes



Please also answer these questions:



* Which Klaviyo flow would you prioritize first for a fine-jewelry Shopify store, and why?

* What filters should be used to stop an abandoned-checkout flow after a customer purchases?

* How would you treat a $10,000 abandoned checkout differently from a $500 abandoned checkout?

* How would you diagnose a Shopify store where Added to Cart is tracking but Viewed Product is not?

* What information would you need from us before beginning the project?



Applications that do not begin with **DIAMOND** or do not include examples of previous Klaviyo work will not be considered.



## Our Ideal Candidate



The right person is detail-oriented, proactive and able to combine technical Klaviyo knowledge with good judgment and elegant communication.



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the complete setup, explain their decisions clearly and help us turn
 marketing into a professional long-term sales and customer-retention channel.



There is potential for ongoing work managing campaigns, testing flows, analyzing results and improving performance after the initial project is completed.

description:
We run a high margin U.S. real estate niche most investors can't touch: partial deeds and title problems. We help families untangle complicated ownership and unlock properties nobody else knows how to close. The deals are unusual, the margins are strong, and the best closer on our team is closing roughly one deal a week.



We're hiring one more sharp closer. The bar is high on purpose.





What This Is





A real sales seat. You research families, get on the phone every day, and build trust with people in hard situations.

This is not a VA role. Not admin. Not "manage a pipeline quietly." You dial, you talk, you move deals.

You'll own leads inside Lofty (our CRM), dial through Dialpad, and pull contacts with SmartSkip.





Your Day





Daily huddle, 10:00 AM ET, cameras on, no exceptions. We review numbers, wins, and blockers together.

75 dials per day minimum, tracked. Your dials, contacts, and conversion are visible to the team every day.

Roughly 40 to 50% research (obituaries, court and tax records, identifying heirs and the real decision maker) and 50 to 60% outreach (calls, texts, voi
s, follow up).

We run a two call close structure. You'll learn it cold.

title: Shopify Store Growth Operator| Beauty, Health, Wellness and Fitness Brand | Private Label Product Research to Scaled Ads
description:
**Ecommerce Growth Operator | Beauty, Health, Wellness and Fitness Brand | Private Label Product Research to Scaled Ads**



---



We are building a private label beauty, health, wellness, and fitness ecommerce brand, starting with one hero product and scaling into a full brand portfolio over time. We need someone who can own the entire process from product research to a live, selling store under our own brand name. Not someone who waits for direction. Someone who has done this before and can do it again, faster and better.



This is not a task based VA role. This is an operator role. You will start from zero, find the winning product yourself, source a supplier who can private label it under our brand, build the store yourself, launch the ads yourself, and scale what works.



---



**Why private label matters here**

We are not building a one time dropship test. We are building brand equity we can own, protect margin on, and scale into a real portfolio. That only works if the product carries our name, our packaging, and our identity from day one, not a generic version anyone else can sell too.



---



**What success looks like**

A validated hero product with a live, fully built Shopify store within the first few days of starting. First sales within the first two weeks. From there, a clear kill or scale decision backed by real data, and 
ntum toward testing the next product in the portfolio.



---



**What you will actually be doing**



You will research products in the beauty, health, wellness, and fitness space using more than one method, not just one tool. You are validating real demand through revenue data, active ad counts, ad run duration, and competition levels before a single product moves forward.



Once you find a winning concept you will find and vet a supplier who can manufacture or package it under our brand, negotiate minimum order quantities, and build a relationship you can depend on long term.



You will build a dedicated Shopify store around that product fast. Premium theme, conversion focused landing page, bundle pricing, and trust elements that make a stranger feel safe buying from a brand they have never heard of.



Before anything goes live you set up tracking properly.
 Business Manager, pixel installation, event verification, and a secondary attribution tool to cross check your data.



Then you launch. You test with a small structured budget, monitor daily performance signals, and make kill or scale decisions based on the numbers. Once a product wins you manage it ongoing while starting research on the next one.



---



**Tools you need to have real experience with**



For product research: Kalodata, PiPiAds,
 Ads Library, and organic TikTok scrolling to catch what is trending before it shows up in the data tools. We want someone who cross references multiple sources, not someone relying on one tool alone.



For store building: Shopify and premium conversion focused themes such as Shrine or Elixir, or a close equivalent.



For tracking and ads:
 Business Manager including pixel setup and event verification, plus a secondary independent attribution tool such as WeTrack or similar.



For conversion and retention: bundle pricing apps such as Kaching Bundle, and subscription apps such as Loop Subscription, or close equivalents.



For creative: Canva and AI image tools such as Midjourney or Adobe Firefly.



For daily workflow: AI assistants such as ChatGPT or Claude.



If you have used a direct equivalent to any tool listed, tell us specifically which one and how it compares.



Start your application with the word "HERO" so we know you read this in full. Right after that, in your first line, tell us how many products you typically need to test to find one validated winner, based on your own experience.

---



**Trial period and working hours**



This role starts with a 30 day paid trial. The purpose is simple, we want to see real execution and reliability before committing long term, not just a good interview.



During the trial your working hours need to be 7 PM to 1 AM CDT so we can collaborate and communicate in real time. Communication will be in Slack throughout.



If the PAID trial goes well, we move into a long term role, full time or part time depending on what you are looking for, with a base rate plus performance upside tied to the sales you generate.



---



**You are the right person if**



You have personally researched and validated a product before spending money on it, using more than one method. You have found and vetted a supplier for private label manufacturing, not just dropshipping. You have built a Shopify store from scratch fast, without needing a template handed to you. You have launched and managed Meta ad campaigns and can walk us through what happened. You can commit to the 7 PM to 1 AM CDT schedule for the full trial period. You move fast and do not need constant supervision once you understand the standards.



---



**You are not the right fit if**



You have never done product research on your own. You have never built a Shopify store independently. You have no private label sourcing experience, only basic dropshipping. You have never managed a live ad account with real budget. You cannot commit to the trial hours. You need heavy hand holding to get started.



---



**How to apply**



Do not just tell us you can do this. Show us.



Submit a short plan for how you would approach your first product test with us, from research through to launch, including which tools you would use at each step and your estimated timeline to get a store live and ads running.



Walk us through a product you personally researched and validated before, including what data convinced you it was worth testing.



Tell us about a private label supplier relationship you built and how you managed it.



Walk us through a Shopify store you built from scratch, including the theme you used.



Tell us which attribution tool you use alongside
 Ads Manager and why.



Share a Meta ad campaign you ran, the budget, and what happened.



Applications that copy and paste generic experience will not be considered. Applications that show a real plan and real process will get a fast response.

title: Direct-Response Video Editor — Short-Form + VSL Ads (UGC / Story / Animation / Native)
description:
We're a story-driven DTC brand hiring a direct-response editor to cut ads for
, Instagram, and TikTok. One brand, long-term, real room to grow with us.



Read this before applying, because it's the whole job:



We are not hiring a videographer. We're hiring an editor who thinks like a marketer. Your work is judged on one thing — did the ad stop the scroll and hold it — not on how cinematic it looks. Clarity beats cleverness. We chase response, not aesthetics. If your instinct with raw footage is to color-grade it, add slick transitions, and "clean it up," we're not a fit — and that's okay.



What you'll actually be cutting

Ads that feel like a real person posted them, not like a brand ran them — UGC-style testimonials, emotional story ads, animation ads, VSLs, AI-voiceover + b-roll ads, text-on-screen ads, native creatives, hooks, product demos. Raw and real beats polished, every time. The goal is to not make it look like an ad.



The craft we expect (this is the standard, not a wishlist)

You understand concepts, not just cuts. You get the idea behind an ad — the angle, the belief it shifts, the emotional arc — and you edit to serve it. You can tell why an ad works, second by second, not just that it "looks clean."

You're not tied to one format — you can build whatever the concept needs. UGC testimonial, story ad, VSL, AI-voiceover-over-b-roll, text-on-screen, split-screen, before/after, static-to-video, animation. You pick the format that serves the idea and you can cut all of them well.

Animation ads. You can build animated story ads and simple 3D/animated explainers that make an invisible mechanism visible — showing the viewer what's happening so the idea lands instantly.

Hook in the first 3 seconds. A pattern interrupt that stops the scroll — never a logo or a polite intro. You understand open loops and curiosity gaps and use them to buy the next second.

Retention over everything. Every second earns the next. You cut to an emotional arc — relatability ? tension ? relief — not to a checklist of clips.

You use contrast to control the eye. Black-and-white with a single accent color, before/after, tension into relief, loud into quiet — visual and emotional contrast to pull attention exactly where it needs to go.

B-roll that matches the voiceover word-for-word, and clean text-on-screen that carries the message with the sound off (feeds autoplay muted). Clips run ~3–5s, natural light, no staged studio look, product revealed late — after the story earns it, never up front.

Sound design as timing, not decoration. Music, zoom, and SFX move with the emotion — the track shifts at each structural beat, the zoom lands on the emphasis line, the punch hits on the reveal.

Keep UGC raw. Slightly awkward, imperfect, conversational — that's the authenticity that converts. Don't polish it out.

Native by default: 9:16 vertical, tight or long depending on the concept, fast clean captions/subtitles, no watermarks or bugs.

Tools & workflow

Editing: Premiere / CapCut / Final Cut — whatever you're fastest and sharpest in. We care about output, not software.

Claude is our brain for everything, and it's a big plus if you already work in it: scripts, natural-speech conversion, creative briefs, ad breakdowns, and second-by-second teardowns all run through Claude. The more fluent you are with it, the faster you'll move.

Plus whatever helps you execute better — AI voiceover (ElevenLabs), AI animation/video generation (Kling, Seedance), and spy research on the Meta Ad Library / AdSpy to study winners and losers. Show us the tools that make you faster and sharper.

You'll live in the research loop: study winners and losers, break them down beat-by-beat, form a hypothesis, iterate fast. You're expected to have opinions on why an ad worked — not just assemble footage.

What we provide

Raw footage, scripts and hooks, creative direction, winning-ad examples, and our internal training so you learn our exact style and keep getting better.



What you keep

Base pay plus a performance bonus on every winning ad you cut. The better your ads convert, the more you make.



How to apply (read carefully — incomplete applications are skipped)

This is the filter, on purpose. Do all three or we move on:



1. Portfolio of real DR ads. 3–5 actual ads you cut — UGC, story, VSL, animation, text-on-screen, whatever you're strongest at — vertical, native, made to sell. No wedding videos, no YouTube intros, no cinematic reels, no motion-graphics showreels. If your best work is polished brand films, we're not your brand.



2. Pick a winning ad you admire (any brand) and tell us, in one paragraph, why it works — second by second. Hook, why it holds, where the emotion turns. We're reading for whether you think in concepts and retention or just "nice edits."



3. Answer this: You get raw phone footage of a customer talking about our product — a little awkward, natural light, not "produced." Do you (a) polish it into a clean cinematic testimonial, or (b) keep it raw and slightly imperfect — and why?



Bonus if you've edited ecommerce ads before, can move between formats (UGC, VSL, animation, text-on-screen), work in Claude, communicate clearly, and turn revisions around fast.

Core values: Igloo Insurance Corporate Values

1. The Golden Rule

Definition: Treat others as you would like to be treated.

Origin: The Golden Rule has been a guiding ethical principle across various cultures and religions for centuries, famously stated in the Bible as "Do unto others as you would have them do unto you."

How We Live It: We treat our janitor the same way we treat our CEO. Everyone deserves respect, kindness, and fairness. Whether it’s a teammate, a vendor, or a customer, we believe in treating others as we would treat our own grandmother—with care, patience, and sincerity.

How Customers Experience It: We treat every customer interacting with empathy and fairness. Whether you’re a first-time homebuyer or a corporate risk manager, we give you the same level of attention and respect. We are here to help, and offer expert advice, not just to sell a policy.

2. Transparency

Definition: Honesty in all we do—no fine print, no hidden fees, no sugarcoating.

How We Live It: Insurance is complex, and many consumers don’t fully understand their coverage. That’s why we take the time to explain policies, how underwriters determine rates, and why premiums may increase. If something goes wrong, like a claim denial, we don’t delay delivering bad news. We believe in open, clear communication at all times.

How Customers Experience It: Independent agents at Igloo Insurance act as sherpas, guiding clients through the insurance landscape—whether they’re homeowners, drivers, parents, business owners, or corporate risk managers. We tell it like it is, ensuring you understand what you’re buying and why. No gimmicks, no hidden fees, no games.

3. Balance

Definition: Work to live, don’t live to work.

How We Live It: My parents used to say work hard, play hard, everything in moderation. It’s important as the average American works over 90,000 hours in their lifetime. That’s why we strive to be a "Best Place to Work," offering ample time off, fair wages, and a culture that values personal well-being. We will cater to mothers, those eager to learn but aren’t credentialed for large agency work, those without college degrees, those with criminal records, and especially seasoned retired folks who may not desire the standard 9 to 5 grind.

How Customers Experience It: We won’t push you to over insure, nor will we encourage the cheapest coverage that might leave you vulnerable. Everyone has a different risk appetite—some are risk-averse, others are risk-takers. We help you strike the right balance in your insurance program, aligning your premiums, limits, and deductibles with your financial comfort level.

4. Quality

Definition: Quality over quantity—buy it for life.

How We Live It: We drive Japanese cars until the head gaskets blow. We drink from stainless steel coffee mugs. In our homes and offices, we invest in durable, long-lasting products rather than cheap, single-use alternatives.

How Customers Experience It: We focus on coverage first, not just price. We work with financially sound, A+ rated insurance carriers, ensuring you get reliable coverage when you need it most. Our service timelines align with your needs—whether it's a quick turnaround for a COI or a thorough annual review of your policies. With us, you get quality protection that lasts.
