title: Trailer Management Admin (Urgent)
description:
GH Logistics (AJG Transport) is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup to delivery.



If you’re someone who enjoys structured execution, asset visibility, and maintaining operational accuracy behind the scenes, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

You support the Trailer Manager in overseeing a fleet of 400+ trailers across multiple carriers and terminals. You play a critical role in ensuring every trailer is accounted for, properly assigned, compliant, and operational. This is not a passive data entry role. You're the person who keeps the fleet picture accurate and flags problems before they cost us time and money. If you thrive on structure, take pride in clean records, and don't let things slip through the cracks, this role was built for you.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor, update, and reconcile trailer locations across the network on a daily basis

• Coordinate with dispatchers, drivers, and terminals to ensure accurate trailer assignments and timely movement

• Track trailer availability, maintenance schedules, and repair status

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date trailer documentation (registrations, inspections, tags, insurance)

• Support reporting on trailer utilization, downtime, and compliance

• Identify discrepancies, missing updates, or unreported trailer statuses and escalate promptly

• Assist in improving internal trailer tracking systems for better visibility and accuracy

• Execute processes consistently with strong attention to detail

• Collaborate cross-functionally with dispatch, compliance, and maintenance teams



What Success Looks Like

• Trailer locations and statuses are consistently accurate and fully reconciled

• Assignments, availability, and movements are properly documented and updated in real time

• Maintenance and compliance records are complete and up to date

• Discrepancies are identified early and resolved before impacting operations

• Reporting on utilization and downtime is clean, accurate, and actionable

• Communication across departments is clear, timely, and structured



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in fleet management, logistics coordination, dispatch, or similar live operational roles (not general admin work)

• Strong attention to detail with high accuracy in tracking and record-keeping

• Organized and capable of managing multiple data points across systems and teams

• Clear and professional communication skills across departments

• Familiarity with platforms such as Samsara, LoadStop, or similar tracking systems (a plus)

• Proactive mindset, able to identify and address issues before they escalate

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Logistics tools

• Reliable internet connection and fully equipped remote work setup

• Team oriented, coachable, and aligned with structured processes



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full time permanent remote role

• Direct Hire to a US Company (not agency or BPO)

• Current needed shifts: Monday - Friday 7 AM - 5 PM CDT | Tuesday - Sunday 3 PM - 1 AM CDT | Wednesday - Monday 7 AM - 5 PM CDT

• Possible Shift (only if assigned): 11 PM - 9 AM CDT (San Antonio time)

• Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations

• Zoom presence required (camera on throughout shift)

• Possible Hubstaff time tracking during shifts, but is not currently in use.



What You'll Get

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Paid biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Stable & long-term position. This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us.

• Direct access to US executive leadership. You're not buried in a call center reporting to a middle manager. You work directly with our operations team.

• Real operations work.



Who Thrives Here

• People who've worked in a US freight brokerage or 3PL and want something more stable

• Former fleet coordinators, logistics admins, or dispatch support staff who are tired of BPO environments

• Fleet admins who take ownership. You don't clock in and zone out. You manage trailers like they are your business.

• People who want to grow into leadership but need the right company to do it in.



Who This Isn't For

• General VAs looking for easy remote work. This is real logistics and not admin tasks.

• People who need constant supervision or step by step instructions for every task

• Anyone who can't commit to US shift hours consistently

• Candidates without actual freight/logistics experience. We don't have time to teach the basics.



This role is built for someone who takes pride in maintaining control over moving assets, ensuring trailers are accounted for, properly assigned, and always operational. If you value structure, accuracy, and keeping operations running clean behind the scenes, you’ll thrive in this role.

Who We’re Looking For

• Highly organized and comfortable working with multiple spreadsheets, dashboards, and group chats

• Communicates clearly and professionally via chat and

Why Join GH Logistics?

• Structured systems and clear expectations

• Hands on leadership and direct feedback

• Defined KPIs and measurable growth

Schedule & Work Setup

This role is built for someone who genuinely enjoys following freight in motion, monitoring shipments, confirming updates, and making sure deliveries stay on track. title: Property Operations, AI & Process Improvement Virtual Assistant
description:
Property Operations, AI & Process Improvement Virtual Assistant

Part-Time Position With Opportunity to Grow to Full-Time



Steadvera Group is seeking a highly organized, analytical and technology-oriented Virtual Assistant to support our growing real-estate, furnished-rental, asset-management and consulting operations.



This position will begin at approximately 20 hours per week at $5 USD per hour. For the right person, the position is intended to grow into a stable 30- to 40-hour-per-week long-term role.



This is not a basic data-entry position. We need someone who can manage detailed assignments while also thinking critically, solving problems, analyzing information, conducting research and recommending practical solutions.



The successful candidate will support several areas:



Short-term and mid-term rental operations

Property launch and project coordination

Booking and calendar administration

Financial and accounting administration

Tax-strategy documentation coordination

Artificial intelligence and automation

Website updates and digital support

Lean manufacturing and Operational Excellence projects

Root-cause analysis and structured problem-solving

Data analysis, reporting and savings tracking



The person selected will coordinate and support operations but will not have final executive authority. Final business, legal, tax, contractual and financial decisions will remain with the owner or an authorized family leadership representative.



Primary Responsibilities

Property Launch and Project Coordination

Build and maintain the Steadvera Property Launch Master Plan.

Create separate launch checklists for each property and rental unit.

Track furniture, appliances, supplies, utilities, internet, smart locks, security systems, photography, inspections, listings and launch dates.

Convert instructions into clear tasks with an owner, priority, due date and status.

Follow up on overdue assignments.

Identify risks, missing information and tasks that could delay a property launch.

Maintain a master dashboard covering all properties and business entities.

Prepare a weekly status report showing completed work, open tasks, overdue items, risks and decisions needed from the owner.

Short-Term and Mid-Term Rental Operations

Support the administration of short-term and mid-term furnished rental properties.

Maintain accurate booking, occupancy and guest records.

Coordinate availability across Airbnb, Furnished Finder, direct bookings and other platforms.

Immediately block unavailable dates on all applicable calendars after a reservation is confirmed.

Review calendars for overlapping reservations and double-booking risks.

Track inquiries, reservations, extensions, cancellations, arrivals and departures.

Coordinate cleaning, inspection and maintenance schedules around guest stays.

Maintain records of average nightly rates, monthly rates, average length of stay, occupancy and booking lead time.

Assist with the setup and administration of property-management software or a channel manager.



Experience with Airbnb, Furnished Finder, hospitality, corporate housing, short-term rentals or mid-term rentals is strongly preferred.



Property Listings and Guest Communications

Create, upload, review and update furnished-rental listings.

Review property descriptions, titles, amenities, photographs, fees, house rules and local-area information.

Research listing keywords and ways to improve booking visibility.

Draft professional guest messages for inquiries, confirmations, check-in, check-out, extensions, maintenance concerns and payment reminders.

Maintain approved guest-message templates.

Identify situations that require owner review or approval.

Pricing and Market Research

Research local peak seasons and demand patterns.

Maintain a calendar of graduations, festivals, sporting events, holidays, conferences, hospital demand, corporate projects and other events affecting rental demand.

Review comparable furnished rental listings.

Track competitor pricing, amenities, availability, fees and minimum-stay requirements.

Analyze occupancy, booking lead time, nightly rates and length of stay.

Prepare recommendations for peak-season pricing, weekday and weekend rates, extended-stay discounts, opening promotions and minimum-stay requirements.

Support all recommendations with clear facts and data.

Obtain owner approval before making significant pricing changes.

Cleaning, Maintenance and Vendor Coordination

Maintain an organized directory of cleaners, contractors, maintenance technicians, landscapers and other vendors.

Schedule cleaning, inspection, repair and maintenance appointments.

Confirm appointments and follow up until work is completed.

Collect invoices, receipts, photographs and completion documentation.

Maintain an open work-order tracker.

Escalate urgent property, guest, safety, electrical, plumbing, security or HVAC issues.

Identify repeated problems that may require root-cause analysis.

Inventory and Inspection Management

Maintain a room-by-room inventory for each property.

Track furniture, appliances, electronics, linens, kitchen supplies, bathroom supplies, décor, safety equipment and consumable supplies.

Record purchase dates, costs, warranties, model numbers and serial numbers when available.

Maintain turnover and inspection checklists.

Review inspection reports and photographs.

Identify missing, damaged, worn or low-stock items.

Prepare purchasing and replenishment recommendations.

Track recurring damages, shortages or replacement needs.

Tenant Billing and Accounts Receivable

Review utility bills for a long-term rental property.

Calculate amounts tenants are required to reimburse.

Prepare monthly tenant invoices for owner approval.

Prepare and track a $300 administrative fee associated with adding another occupant to a lease.

Track invoice dates, due dates, payments and outstanding balances.

Maintain supporting documentation and tenant correspondence.

Send approved invoices and payment reminders.

Escalate overdue balances or disputes to the owner.

Finance and Accounting Administration



A finance, accounting, bookkeeping or business background is strongly preferred.



Responsibilities may include:



Organizing income and expense records

Coding expenses by property, company, vendor and category

Maintaining accounts-payable and accounts-receivable trackers

Matching receipts to transactions

Identifying missing receipts or documentation

Organizing bank and credit-card reconciliation packages

Preparing property-level financial summaries

Comparing budgeted costs with actual costs

Tracking furnishing, launch and operating expenses

Tracking booking-platform payouts and fees

Preparing occupancy, revenue, expense and cash-flow reports

Coordinating with the company’s bookkeeper, accountant and tax professionals



The candidate should understand basic concepts such as revenue, operating expenses, capital expenditures, accounts payable, accounts receivable, cash flow, profit and loss, net operating income, return on investment and break-even analysis.



Experience with QuickBooks Online, Stessa, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets or similar financial systems is preferred.



Tax-Strategy Documentation Coordination



The company will work with qualified accountants, CPAs, attorneys and tax professionals to evaluate and implement approved real-estate tax strategies.



The Virtual Assistant will not provide tax or legal advice. The assistant will coordinate the administrative documentation needed by the owner and professional advisors.



Responsibilities may include:



Maintaining a tax-strategy action tracker

Recording recommendations received from qualified professionals

Converting approved recommendations into tasks and deadlines

Coordinating documentation requested by the CPA or accountant

Organizing property closing statements and purchase documents

Tracking property placed-in-service dates

Organizing furniture, appliance, renovation and improvement invoices

Maintaining fixed-asset and purchase records

Organizing mortgage interest, property tax, insurance and utility records

Maintaining reservation histories and average-length-of-stay reports

Maintaining owner participation and property-activity logs when directed

Coordinating cost-segregation documents

Collecting year-end booking-platform statements

Identifying missing documentation

Preparing organized document packages for the accountant or CPA

Following up on outstanding questions and action items



The assistant must understand the difference between organizing tax documentation and providing tax advice. Final classifications, elections, deductions and tax decisions must be made by qualified professionals.



Artificial Intelligence and Automation



Strong experience using artificial intelligence tools is preferred.



Responsibilities may include:



Using ChatGPT and other approved AI tools for research, drafting, summaries, data organization, property descriptions, spreadsheet formulas and report preparation

Creating reusable prompts and AI-assisted workflows

Verifying AI-generated information before it is used

Identifying repetitive work that could be automated

Creating templates, checklists, forms and standard operating procedures

Documenting workflows so they can be repeated consistently

Protecting confidential information and following company rules regarding AI use



Applicants should be prepared to explain which AI tools they have used and provide examples of how they used them to improve productivity.



Website and Digital Support

Assist with updates to company and property webpages.

Add or revise approved text, photographs, FAQs, property details and local-area information.

Review webpages for broken links, outdated information, missing content, formatting problems and spelling errors.

Review webpages for mobile presentation and ease of use.

Maintain a website-change tracker.

Coordinate updates with the company’s web designer.

Assist with basic search-engine optimization and keyword research.

Support landing pages, contact forms and property-information pages.



Experience with WordPress, Wix, Squarespace or similar platforms is preferred. Basic HTML or CSS knowledge is helpful but not required.



Lean Manufacturing, Engineering and Operational Excellence Support



Experience supporting manufacturing, engineering, quality, supply-chain, continuous-improvement or Operational Excellence teams is strongly preferred.



Assignments may include:



Maintaining Lean Six Sigma and continuous-improvement project trackers

Organizing plant-level savings projects and action plans

Tracking project targets, actual performance, forecasts and validated savings

Preparing project charters, timelines and executive summaries

Maintaining DMAIC documentation

Cleaning, organizing and validating operational data

Preparing charts, dashboards, Pareto analyses and trend summaries

Creating process maps and SIPOC diagrams

Supporting A3 problem-solving documentation

Maintaining corrective-action trackers

Tracking risks, countermeasures, owners and due dates

Preparing meeting notes and action-item reports

Following up with project-tea
mbers

Preparing PowerPoint presentations and Excel reports

Supporting return-on-investment, payback and cost-benefit calculations

Distinguishing estimated savings from implemented and financially validated savings

Identifying missing data, inconsistencies and unsupported assumptions

Researching manufacturing technologies and process-improvement opportunities



Applicants are not expected to independently solve complex technical engineering problems. However, they must be able to understand instructions, analyze data, ask intelligent questions and organize technical information accurately.



Root-Cause Analysis and Structured Problem-Solving



The successful candidate must be able to investigate problems rather than simply report them.



The candidate should be able to:



Define a problem clearly

Gather relevant information and data

Separate facts from assumptions

Identify possible causes

Determine the most likely root cause

Recommend corrective and preventive actions

Follow up to verify whether the solution worked

Document lessons learned



Experience with several of the following tools is strongly preferred:



5 Whys

Fishbone or Ishikawa diagrams

Pareto analysis

Process mapping

SIPOC

Value-stream mapping

FMEA

PDCA

DMAIC

A3 problem solving

Kaizen

5S

Standard work

Corrective and preventive action

Risk assessment

Control plans

KPI dashboards

Waste and cost reduction

Productivity analysis

Downtime analysis

Quality improvement

Cost-benefit and return-on-investment analysis



Formal Lean Six Sigma certification is helpful but not required.



Required Qualifications

Strong written and spoken English

Excellent reading comprehension

Excellent organization and attention to detail

Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills

Ability to investigate issues and recommend solutions

Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills

Ability to use formulas, filters, conditional formatting and pivot tables

Ability to organize and analyze business data

Experience using ChatGPT or other AI tools

Ability to verify AI-generated information

Strong online research skills

Professional written communication

Backup plan for internet or power interruptions

Willingness to learn new systems

Strongly Preferred Experience

Airbnb

Applicants do not need to have experience in every area. Candidates with excellent analytical ability, strong technology skills and the ability to learn quickly are encouraged to apply.

title: Shopify Store Growth Manager – Build, Launch, Scale  & Manage  Brand Store
description:
**Ecommerce Growth Operator | Beauty, Health, Wellness and Fitness Brand | Private Label Product Research to Scaled Ads**



---



We are building a private label beauty, health, wellness, and fitness ecommerce brand, starting with one hero product and scaling into a full brand portfolio over time. We need someone who can own the entire process from product research to a live, selling store under our own brand name. Not someone who waits for direction. Someone who has done this before and can do it again, faster and better.



This is not a task based VA role. This is an operator role. You will start from zero, find the winning product yourself, source a supplier who can private label it under our brand, build the store yourself, launch the ads yourself, and scale what works.



---



**Why private label matters here**



We are not building a one time dropship test. We are building brand equity we can own, protect margin on, and scale into a real portfolio. That only works if the product carries our name, our packaging, and our identity from day one, not a generic version anyone else can sell too.



---



**What success looks like**



A validated hero product with a live, fully built Shopify store within the first few days of starting. First sales within the first two weeks. From there, a clear kill or scale decision backed by real data, and 
ntum toward testing the next product in the portfolio.



---



**What you will actually be doing**



You will research products in the beauty, health, wellness, and fitness space using more than one method, not just one tool. You are validating real demand through revenue data, active ad counts, ad run duration, and competition levels before a single product moves forward.



Once you find a winning concept you will find and vet a supplier who can manufacture or package it under our brand, negotiate minimum order quantities, and build a relationship you can depend on long term.



You will build a dedicated Shopify store around that product fast. Premium theme, conversion focused landing page, bundle pricing, and trust elements that make a stranger feel safe buying from a brand they have never heard of.



Before anything goes live you set up tracking properly.
 Business Manager, pixel installation, event verification, and a secondary attribution tool to cross check your data.



Then you launch. You test with a small structured budget, monitor daily performance signals, and make kill or scale decisions based on the numbers. Once a product wins you manage it ongoing while starting research on the next one.



---



**Tools you need to have real experience with**



For product research: Kalodata, PipiAds,
 Ads Library, and organic TikTok scrolling to catch what is trending before it shows up in the data tools. We want someone who cross references multiple sources, not someone relying on one tool alone.



For store building: Shopify and premium conversion focused themes such as Shrine or Elixir, or a close equivalent.



For tracking and ads:
 Business Manager including pixel setup and event verification, plus a secondary independent attribution tool such as WeTrack or similar.



For conversion and retention: bundle pricing apps such as Kaching Bundle, and subscription apps such as Loop Subscription, or close equivalents.



For creative: Canva and AI image tools such as Midjourney or Adobe Firefly.



For daily workflow: AI assistants such as ChatGPT or Claude.



If you have used a direct equivalent to any tool listed, tell us specifically which one and how it compares.



---



**Trial period and working hours**



This role starts with a 30 day PAID trial. The purpose is simple, we want to see real execution and reliability before committing long term, not just a good interview.



During the trial your working hours need to be 7 PM to 1 AM CDT so we can collaborate and communicate in real time. Communication will be in Slack throughout.



If the trial goes well, we move into a long term role, full time or part time depending on what you are looking for, with a base rate plus performance upside tied to the sales you generate.



---



**You are the right person if**



You have personally researched and validated a product before spending money on it, using more than one method. You have found and vetted a supplier for private label manufacturing, not just dropshipping. You have built a Shopify store from scratch fast, without needing a template handed to you. You have launched and managed Meta ad campaigns and can walk us through what happened. You can commit to the 7 PM to 1 AM CDT schedule for the full trial period. You move fast and do not need constant supervision once you understand the standards.



---



**You are not the right fit if**



You have never done product research on your own. You have never built a Shopify store independently. You have no private label sourcing experience, only basic dropshipping. You have never managed a live ad account with real budget. You cannot commit to the trial hours. You need heavy hand holding to get started.



---



**How to apply**



Do not just tell us you can do this. Show us.



Start your application with the word "HERO" so we know you read this in full. Right after that, in your first line, tell us how many products you typically need to test to find one validated winner, based on your own experience.



Submit a short plan for how you would approach your first product test with us, from research through to launch, including which tools you would use at each step and your estimated timeline to get a store live and ads running.



Walk us through a product you personally researched and validated before, including what data convinced you it was worth testing.



Tell us about a private label supplier relationship you built and how you managed it.



Walk us through a Shopify store you built from scratch, including the theme you used.



Tell us which attribution tool you use alongside
 Ads Manager and why.



Share a Meta ad campaign you ran, the budget, and what happened.



Applications that copy and paste generic experience will not be considered. Applications that show a real plan and real process will get a fast response.

title: Experienced Outbound Appointment Setter — Full-Time Warm Leads
description:
Prosper is hiring an experienced Outbound Appointment Setter for its solar, home energy savings, and Prosper Shield programs. This is a full-time production role for a proven phone-sales professional—not an entry-level role and not a place to learn outbound calling from scratch.



You must already know how to take a warm homeowner lead, build immediate trust, ask smart qualifying questions, handle real objections, and set a high-quality appointment for a closer. We need someone who can step into a disciplined system and perform quickly with minimal handholding.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Call warm, opted-in homeowners during U.S. business hours, Monday through Friday

- Work inside our GoHighLevel power dialer and CRM using a proven process

- Run discovery, establish interest, qualify accurately, handle objections, and set appointments that show up ready for the closer

- Keep complete, clean notes, dispositions, and follow-up activity inside GoHighLevel

- Protect the customer experience and lead quality while maintaining reliable daily activity



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

- At least 3 years of successful outbound appointment-setting, SDR, live-transfer, telemarketing, or phone-sales experience in U.S.-facing campaigns

- A track record of setting qualified appointments consistently—not merely making calls or taking inbound support tickets

- Strong experience with a CRM and power dialer; GoHighLevel experience is a major advantage

- Able to explain the campaigns you have worked, the audiences you called, your typical appointment volume, and how you protected appointment quality

- Clear, confident, easy-to-understand English; neutral or American accent strongly preferred

- Strong discovery, listening, objection-handling, and follow-up discipline

- Full-time availability aligned with U.S. business hours, 40 hours per week

- Reliable high-speed internet, professional headset, and quiet work environment



THIS IS NOT A BEGINNER ROLE

Do not apply if you need basic calling training, have never set qualified appointments, cannot work full-time U.S. business hours, or are looking only for part-time or administrative work. We provide the workflow, standards, and performance feedback; you bring the proven calling skill and professional judgment.



WHY PROSPER

- Warm, opted-in leads—no list building or random cold outreach

- Clear systems and accountability for people who already know how to perform

- A serious growth path for strong producers: Setter to Senior Setter, Closer, Coach, or Team Leader

- We care about lead quality and customer experience, not just activity volume



HOW TO APPLY

Send a short note that includes:

1. Your years of direct outbound appointment-setting experience

2. The U.S.-facing campaigns or industries you have worked

3. Your normal appointment-setting volume and one example of overcoming an objection to set a qualified appointment

4. The CRM and dialers you have used

5. Confirmation that you are available for 40 hours per week during U.S. business hours



Prosper hires carefully. We select based on demonstrated skill, relevant experience, ownership, and interview performance. A formal offer will be provided after the interview process.

title: Group Corporate Controller
description:
Group Corporate Controller – Canada, U.S. and International Finance



We are seeking an exceptional Philippines-based finance executive with active Canadian and U.S. CPA credentials to serve as Group Corporate Controller.



Operating across industrial, manufacturing, drilling, technology, and international markets, our group requires a senior financial executive who can oversee accounting, tax coordination, payroll, reporting, treasury, compliance, controls, and financial planning across Canadian, U.S., and international entities.



The Group Corporate Controller will report directly to the President, maintain a clear understanding of the group’s overall financial position, identify financial and compliance risks early, and provide ownership with practical, evidence-based recommendations.





Position Details



Job title: Group Corporate Controller – Canada, U.S. and International Finance



Location: Fully remote executive position for candidates based in the Philippines



Employment: Full-time, stable, and long-term



Reporting relationship: Reports directly to the President and works with Canadian, U.S., and international tax, legal, banking, insurance, payroll, and audit professionals



Schedule: Requires substantial overlap with Canadian and U.S. business hours, with reasonable flexibility for urgent executive matters



Travel: Occasional company-paid travel to Canada, the United States, or other international locations may be required



Candidates may live anywhere in the Philippines, provided they have a secure professional workspace, reliable primary and backup internet connections, and the required schedule availability.





Mandatory Professional Designations



Applicants must currently hold:



- An active Canadian CPA designation issued by a recognized provincial or territorial CPA organization

- An active U.S. CPA license issued by a U.S. state or other recognized licensing jurisdiction

- Good standing and current CPD or CPE compliance in both jurisdictions



A Philippine CPA license is strongly preferred but is not mandatory.



Passing a CPA examination without holding active Canadian and U.S. credentials does not satisfy these requirements. Candidates who do not currently hold both active credentials should not apply.



Professional credentials and good-standing status will be independently verified for shortlisted candidates.





Required Career Experience



Applicants must have:



- At least 15 years of progressive experience in accounting, controllership, finance, audit, tax, treasury, or corporate financial leadership

- At least five years in a senior position such as Corporate Controller, Group Controller, Finance Director, Head of Finance, Vice President of Finance, Tax Director, or Chief Financial Officer

- Direct professional responsibility for both Canadian and U.S. corporations, not merely academic, advisory-only, or occasional exposure

- Multinational experience involving multiple entities, currencies, banks, jurisdictions, and professional advisory firms

- Experience reporting directly to an owner, President, Chief Executive Officer, Chief Financial Officer, or board of directors

- Proven ability to manage accounting staff, bookkeepers, payroll personnel, consultants, and external accountants

- Executive-level written and spoken English suitable for banking, legal, audit, tax-authority, board, and ownership communications

- Experience with a Big Four or national accounting firm, public company, multinational organization, or major North American business is preferred.

- Experience in industrial operations, drilling, manufacturing, inventory, logistics, import and export, software, technology, or international trading is also desirable.





Canadian Accounting and Tax Expertise



The successful candidate must demonstrate substantial practical experience in:



- Canadian corporate accounting, year-end preparation, adjusting entries, working papers, and financial-statement packages

- Federal and provincial corporate income-tax concepts, including Alberta requirements

- GST, HST, and applicable PST or QST registrations, filings, reconciliations, reviews, and audits

- Canadian payroll, source deductions, taxable benefits, vacation obligations, T4, T4A, Records of Employment, and remittance controls

- T5, NR4, non-resident payments, withholding tax, and information returns

- Canada Revenue Agency accounts, notices, reviews, audits, information requests, objection support, documentation, and correspondence

- Intercompany and shareholder transactions, management fees, loans, dividends, capital assets, and foreign exchange

- Budgeting, forecasting, banking, lender reporting, and coordination with Canadian CPA firms and tax counsel





United States Accounting and Tax Expertise



The successful candidate must also demonstrate substantial practical experience in:



- U.S. corporate accounting and reporting for C corporations and other applicable business structures

- Federal income-tax coordination, tax provisions, estimates, extensions, and year-end tax packages

- State income, franchise, gross-receipts, sales and use tax, nexus, and multistate compliance

- U.S. payroll concepts, federal and state withholding, unemployment obligations, worker classification, W-2, and 1099 processes

- Internal Revenue Service notices, examinations, information requests, penalties, and audit support

- Canada-U.S. transactions, intercompany billing, withholding tax, treaty considerations, foreign reporting, and permanent-establishment risk

- Inventory accounting, landed cost, warehouse controls, fixed assets, depreciation, and capital expenditures

- Coordination with U.S. CPAs, enrolled agents, tax attorneys, payroll firms, banks, and government authorities





International and Multinational Expertise



The successful candidate should be highly capable in:



- Multi-entity consolidations, intercompany eliminations, close management, and global chart-of-accounts governance

- Multi-currency accounting, foreign-exchange gains and losses, exposure monitoring, and treasury controls

- International banking, wire controls, cash management, authorization procedures, and fraud prevention

- Transfer pricing, intercompany agreements, management charges, royalties, services, and cost allocations

- Withholding tax, permanent-establishment risk, treaty considerations, and management of local professional advisers

- Import and export transactions, customs, freight, landed cost, inventory in transit, and supply-chain accounting

- Coordinating multi-jurisdiction compliance through local accountants, auditors, tax specialists, and legal advisers

- Applying IFRS and U.S. GAAP to practical accounting and reporting matters





Principal Responsibilities



The Group Corporate Controller will:



- Own and manage monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closes across all entities

- Maintain accurate books, ledgers, reconciliations, journal entries, schedules, and supporting records

- Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, collections, payroll, expenses, and cash application

- Prepare consolidated management financial statements, dashboards, variance analyses, and executive reports

- Develop annual budgets, rolling forecasts, cash-flow models, scenario analyses, and capital-expenditure plans

- Maintain a group-wide compliance calendar covering tax filings, payroll obligations, annual returns, licenses, insurance, banking requirements, and other deadlines

- Coordinate tax planning and compliance with Canadian, U.S., and international advisers

- Present practical financial, tax, cash-flow, and risk-management recommendations to the President and ownership

- Manage banks, credit facilities, liquidity, foreign exchange, wire transfers, and treasury operations

- Establish and enforce internal controls, segregation of duties, approval authorities, fraud-prevention measures, and record-retention requirements

- Improve inventory, warehouse, job-costing, landed-cost, fixed-asset, and profitability reporting

- Support acquisitions, incorporations, reorganizations, international expansion, due diligence, and financing

- Prepare and review audit, tax, banking, insurance, and legal working papers

- Recruit, train, supervise, and evaluate finance and accounting personnel

- Identify errors, waste, duplicate costs, control weaknesses, process failures, tax exposures, and cash-flow risks

- Serve as a discreet, solutions-oriented, and trusted senior financial adviser to the President





Systems and Technology Requirements



Applicants should have:



- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas, PivotTables, Power Query, data validation, financial modelling, and error controls

- Strong experience with QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, or both

- Experience with NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, Oracle, Sage Intacct, or a comparable ERP platform

- Experience with payroll, expense, accounts-payable automation, banking, inventory, and financial-reporting systems

- The ability to improve financial systems, automate workflows, and maintain reliable digital audit trails

- Strong standards for cybersecurity, access control, confidentiality, and secure financial-information handling



Power BI or comparable dashboard and business-intelligence experience is preferred.





Professional and Leadership Standards



The successful candidate must demonstrate:



- Exceptional integrity, discretion, confidentiality, and professional judgment

- Strong executive ownership and accountability

- Exacting standards for reconciliations, documentation, controls, and reporting

- The ability to identify problems before they become material financial or compliance issues

- Evidence-based decision-making and practical problem-solving

- Clear communication with ownership, employees, banks, auditors, tax authorities, legal advisers, and other professional stakeholders

- The ability to direct internal personnel and external professional firms effectively

- Reliable follow-through on commitments, deadlines, filings, and corrective actions

- The professional judgment to challenge incomplete, unsupported, or excessively risky decisions

- The ability to remain objective, organized, and effective when handling complex or sensitive matters





Compensation and Executive Support



The proposed compensation package includes:



- PHP 500,000 gross monthly base salary

How to Apply

WCD Group Corporate Controller – [Your Full Name]

Then number and briefly answer the following questions:

Applications that do not use the required subject line, do not begin with the required sentence, do not answer the questions, or consist only of a generic message such as “I am interested” may not be reviewed.

title: GoHighLevel & Full-Stack Web Systems Specialist
description:
Project Driver LLC (Fort Lauderdale, FL) builds marketing and automation systems for US home-services businesses. The company is founder-led by an engineer and runs on requirements-first, test-everything, document-everything.



THE MISSION

The number one job here is simple to say and hard to do: bring in traffic and turn it into conversions, in a repeatable manner. Everything else is a tool for that. The right person understands the whole chain from search result to booked job, and treats anything that doesn't move that chain as a distraction.



THE ROLE

One long-term seat. Starting hours to be determined with the selected candidate, with room to grow into a full-time exclusive position.



SCHEDULE

Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM EST, slight variance depending on project needs. Slightly modified hours can be discussed for the right candidate after proven success.



THE WORK

GoHighLevel: snapshots, workflows, pipelines, calendars, forms, A2P 10DLC, Conversation AI, integrations (n8n, Zapier, webhooks, APIs). Follow-up automations and lead routing that make sense, and attention to what's converting; so the stuff that isn't gets fixed.



WordPress: Elementor, Gutenberg, Rank Math, LiteSpeed, mobile QA, wiring GHL funnels and forms into WP so leads land somewhere. Pages built to convert, not just look good.



SEO: The whole picture. Technical (crawl issues, redirects, Core Web Vitals, site structure), on-page (content, schema, internal links), off-page (links, citations), local through national (GBP, map pack, service-area and multi-location work). Google changes, AI search changes, social feeds into it. Keeping up is part of the job.



Server-side: PHP fixes and small custom builds, cPanel, DNS, SSL, migrations, staging on reseller hosting. All the unglamorous work that keeps the rest running smoothly.



Honesty over everything. Nobody's an expert in all of this on day one. Gaps get trained for the right hire. What's expected is a straight answer on what you can do today versus what you're still learning. "Not yet" is respected. A bluff gets caught, and trust is what we're built on.



WHO THRIVES HERE

This seat runs without supervision. Whoever sits in it owns the work, they're responsible for it, they lead it, and they answer for it. That means dependable and reachable during working hours, no chasing, no radio silence. It means owning a problem until it's solved, researching before asking, and pushing projects forward without being pushed. And it means bringing better ways of working (faster, higher quality) before anyone asks.



NON-NEGOTIABLES

Attention to detail. Everything gets tested before handover, every time.

Communication. Clear progress updates, questions asked early, never radio silence.

Requirements confirmed before building. Documentation good enough that someone else could run it.

Team player, not a yes-man. If the plan has a hole in it, say so and provide a solution.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Describe one automation or build you did end-to-end: the requirement, what broke or almost broke, how you fixed it and documented it.

2. Describe one thing you built that produced traffic, leads, or conversions. What you did, and what happened after.

3. In your own words, one sentence: what does "a site that ranks but doesn't convert" mean to you? Do not use the words "traffic," "funnel," or "optimize" in your answer.

4. For each area under THE WORK, one honest sentence: what you've actually done, or "not yet."

5. Start your application with the word FLYWHEEL. Applications are read by a human who has seen thousands of these. Generic, AI-drafted, or template answers are obvious and get rejected unread.

6. Explain your hands-on experience with each of the following, one line each: A2P 10DLC registration, Conversation AI, workflow webhooks, and GHL's cadence mirror feature.

7. Describe a time you kept a project moving when nobody was checking on you, or when something kept failing and you didn't quit.

8. Provide a live intro video of yourself.

9. Link anything real that you've created: live site, portfolio, case study, GitHub, etc.

-Composite AI-generated people with real product shots into clean, believable lifestyle scenes

-Work across multiple AI tools to get the best result for each job

-Deliver multiple creative variations per brief for split testing

-Think along with us — you understand why a creative works, not just how to make it look good

-Adobe — Photoshop at a senior level. Compositing, lighting correction, retouching, scene-building.

-Canva — Fast execution for variations and iterations.

-AI + Photoshop combined — You generate in AI, you refine in Photoshop. The end result looks like a real photo shoot.

What We're Looking For

title: AI Video Editor  | Consistent  AI Avatar Needed
description:
I am looking for a creative, dependable AI video editor who can turn scripts and  storyboard ideas into polished, engaging video content. The same character must remain visually consistent across scenes, videos, Shorts, Reels,  and other related content. Facial features, hairstyle, clothing, body type, voice, and overall style cannot noticeably change from one asset to another.



This role is best suited for someone who understands that the final video should feel dynamic and professionally produced, not like a series of static slides. You should be comfortable adding purposeful movement, syncing visuals to narration, creating accurate lip-sync when needed, animating text and graphics, and maintaining strong pacing throughout. Experience with AI video editors such as Generating AI video assets (product shots, avatars/UGC-style talent, b-roll, motion) using tools like Higgsfield, Veo, Kling, Runway, or similar is preferred, as well as experience in non-AI video editing.  If you know Vyond, Canva, CapCut is a strong plus, but not mandatory. This will begin as a deliverable-based freelance opportunity, with the potential for ongoing collaboration and expanded responsibilities for the right person, as well as potentially full time position.

Total weekly payment: $15 +$ 5 = 20$

The long-form video will include voice-over and AI-generated B-roll featuring the recurring character and related scenes.

The two short-form videos may include: A YouTube Short with voice-over or a talking character requiring accurate lip-sync; and/or an Instagram Reel using the character as B-roll with written captions or text overlays. Please apply only if you can demonstrate consistent AI characters video generation across multiple scenes or content formats.

title: TikTok & Short-Form Social Media Specialist (Creative + Editing)
description:
HUMPIN HIPPIES | HH Brands LLC

Department: Social Media | Type: Full-Time | Location: Remote





ABOUT HUMPIN HIPPIES



Humpin Hippies (HH Brands LLC) is a fast-growing wholesale wellness brand with a retro-hippie spirit, known for THC-free, vegan, USA-made enhancement gummies (and soon, enhancement honey). We sell B2B into smoke shops, vape shops, convenience stores, adult stores, and an active distributor network across the country.



We're a lean, fast-moving team that values ownership, clean systems, and getting real results — not busywork. If you need everything spelled out for you, this isn't the role. If you see a trend, a hook, or a better edit before anyone tells you to look for it — this is exactly the role.



We will not spoon-feed you. You'll get goals and context — not step-by-step hand-holding. We are looking for someone with real work ethic, sharp judgment, and the initiative to figure things out and execute without being chased.



Quality standard: every single video is assessed. Low-effort, rushed, or sloppy work will NOT be accepted — no exceptions. Pacing, sound, hooks, transitions, polish — all of it is reviewed. We expect flawless execution as the default, not something we have to ask for.



Performance is tracked against clear KPIs. This is not a role where you coast. If performance consistently falls short — missed deliverables, weak engagement, low-effort content — you will be removed from the team. We move fast, we hold a high bar, and we only keep people who meet it.

 and short-form strategy end to end. This is not a filming role — all video content is AI-generated. You'll spot trends before they peak, generate and edit AI video, get content published, engage our community, and turn data into better content week over week.

You should be skilled at generating AI video that looks realistic — not obviously "AI-looking," not clunky, not uncanny — and editing/cutting it into polished, native-feeling short-form content.

5–10 short-form posts published or scheduled per week.

A trend-research list with actionable, ready-to-shoot concepts.

Daily engagement monitoring.

Weekly TikTok analytics report with clear next-week content recommendations.







WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR





Proven ability to generate AI video content that looks realistic — not stiff, not obviously synthetic, not uncanny.

Proof of work is mandatory. Portfolio or examples of AI-generated/edited videos you personally produced. No portfolio, no consideration — no exceptions.

Experience growing or managing a brand TikTok account, ideally with real growth/engagement numbers to show.

Strong analytical instincts — comfortable reading retention and engagement data and translating it into content decisions.

A fast-moving, trend-reactive mindset paired with genuinely good brand judgment.

Really creative — original ideas, not just recycled trends.

Zero tolerance for low-effort work. Every video is reviewed. Sloppy, rushed, or generic content will be rejected — flawless execution is the standard, not the goal.

Accountable to KPIs. Underperformance will not be tolerated long-term — if the numbers and quality aren't there, you will be cut from the team.

Strong work ethic — reliable, proactive, and takes ownership without being chased.

Self-direction. We will not spoon-feed instructions. You should be able to handle yourself, figure things out, and know what to do next without being micromanaged.







WHY JOIN US





Be part of a growing, founder-led wellness brand with real 
ntum.

Lean team — your work has direct, visible impact on company results.

Clear weekly goals and deliverables, not vague busywork.

Room to grow with the company as we scale nationally.

HOW TO APPLY

description:

Before/after transformations, heavy equipment in action, drone-worthy job sites. Our clients range from homeowners to the Indianapolis Colts.



We want to look like the biggest, most professional operator in our state. Your job is to make that happen through consistent, high-quality content.



The Role (Full-Time, 40 hrs/week)

You will own our social media presence end-to-end:

 • Edit short-form videos (Reels / YouTube Shorts /
 video) from raw phone footage our crew shoots on job sites

title: Full-Time Social Media Video Creator — Work Directly With Award-Winning Marketing Founder
description:
Otio Academy is looking for a talented, ambitious and creative Social Media Video Creator to produce short-form video content for a growing UK education brand.

We are looking for someone who understands hooks, storytelling, short-form video pacing, captions, subtitles, editing, content angles and how to make educational content feel engaging online.



You will work directly with the founder of Otio Academy, an internationally recognised marketing leader with 51 international awards.

The Role:

 Reels and possibly 
.



The content will be aimed at students, parents, schools, sports academies and education partners.



You will help turn educational ideas, study advice, academy updates, student support messages and marketing angles into strong short-form content.

- Create short-form videos for Otio Academy.

- Write strong hooks for social media videos.

- Add captions, subtitles, thumbnails, covers and calls to action.

- Turn educational topics into engaging 15–60 second videos.

- Repurpose existing content into Reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts.

- Use AI tools where helpful, such as ChatGPT, Google Flow/Veo, NotebookLM video, Grok Imagine, Canva AI or other AI video/image tools.

- Create content for students, parents and education decision-makers.

- Maintain a weekly content calendar.

- Schedule and post approved content.

- Track basic performance such as views, engagement, saves, comments and best-performing topics.

- Suggest new content ideas based on trends, hooks and audience problems.

- Follow Otio Academy’s brand tone, colours, style and messaging.

- Improve based on feedback and learn direct-response marketing principles.



Content Examples:



- Study tips

- Revision mistakes

- GCSE support

- Exam preparation advice

- Homework reminders

- Parent advice

- Student motivation

- Short educational explainers

- Otio Academy updates

- Seneca and Google Classroom reminders

- Sports academy education support

- SEN / attendance / alternative education support content

- Founder-led thought leadership clips

- Simple educational animations or AI-assisted videos



What Makes This Role Different:



You will not just be asked to “make posts”.



You will learn how a serious marketer thinks about positioning, hooks, messaging, audience psychology, testing, content angles and conversion.



You will receive feedback from someone with 51 international marketing awards and a track record of mentoring people who later moved into senior roles at major global brands and agencies.



This role is ideal for someone who wants to become much better at marketing, content strategy and short-form video.



Requirements:



- Strong portfolio of short-form video work.

- Excellent CapCut and/or Canva skills.

- Good understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.

- Strong written English.

- Good eye for clean, modern design.

- Able to create videos that are clear, engaging and not boring.

- Comfortable using AI tools for scripts, visuals, video concepts or editing support.

- Able to follow feedback without becoming defensive.

- Able to work quickly and improve based on examples.

- Reliable internet connection and clear communication.

- Highly organised and able to manage a weekly content calendar.

- Experience creating content for tutors, schools, academies, coaches, course creators, education brands, family brands or professional service brands is a major advantage.

- Must be willing to complete an OnlineJobs.ph background check before final hiring.

- NBI Clearance preferred.



Important:



You will not need access to student data, Google Classroom student records, parent contact details or internal safeguarding information. This is a public-facing content and marketing role only.



Who Should NOT Apply:



- Do not apply if you only make basic static Canva graphics.

- Do not apply if you cannot show video examples.

- Do not apply if you dislike feedback.

- Do not apply if you are looking for easy repetitive posting only.

- Do not apply if you cannot write clear English captions.

- Do not apply if you are not interested in learning marketing properly.



How to Apply:



Start your application with the phrase “Otio Video Growth Creator” so I know you read the full post.



Please include:



1. A link to your best short-form video portfolio.

2. Your best 3 video examples.

3. The tools you use, such as CapCut, Canva, Adobe, AI video tools or scheduling tools.

4. Examples of social media accounts or brands you have worked on.

5. Whether you have created content for education, tutoring, coaching, courses, family brands or professional services before.

6. How many short videos you can realistically create per week.

7. Your expected monthly salary for full-time work.

8. A short paragraph explaining why you want to learn marketing and content strategy.



Applications without video examples will not be considered.



This is a full-time role for someone who wants to grow.

description:
Job Title: Short-Form Video Editor / Reels Specialist (Part-Time, Long-Term)



About us:

We're a Miami-based human performance and longevity company. We're launching a daily short-form content channel (Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) and need a reliable editor to own our post-production pipeline long-term. This is a growing role that starts part-time and can expand to full-time as our output scales.



What you'll do:

- Take our raw recordings (both long-form sessions and short standalone clips) and turn them into polished, ready-to-post vertical reels

- Use AI-assisted tools (VEED, Submagic, or similar, and we'll cover the subscription) to clip long recordings into multiple shorts, then clean up the output

- Add and proofread captions (accuracy matters, since we use specialized health/science terms)

- Add relevant B-roll and simple graphics to make clips engaging

- Format for 9:16, ensure captions sit in the safe zone, and load finished clips into our scheduler

- Deliver a consistent daily posting queue



The 3 key skills we're looking for:

1. Fast, high-volume short-form editing using AI-assisted tools (VEED, Submagic, CapCut, or similar). You can turn one long recording into many polished clips efficiently.

2. Strong clip selection and hook instinct. You know how to find the most engaging 
nts in a long recording and open each clip with a hook that stops the scroll.

3. Precise, error-free captioning. Accurate transcription and clean caption styling, including careful handling of specialized health and science terminology.



Requirements:

- Proven short-form editing experience (please share 2 to 3 examples of reels/shorts you've edited)

- Comfortable with AI editing tools, or a fast learner willing to use our workflow

- Strong written English and attention to detail (captions must be error-free)

- Reliable, communicative, and available for consistent weekly turnaround

- Bonus: interest in health, fitness, wellness, or longevity content



Hours and pay:

- Part-time to start: around 15 to 20 hrs/week (target of 21 finished clips per week)

- $150 to $200/week depending on experience, reviewed at 90 days

- Clear path to full-time and higher pay as our output scales



To apply:

Start your application with the word "MOTUS" so we know you read this fully. Then tell us: (1) your weekly rate, (2) 2 to 3 samples of short-form work you've edited, and (3) which editing tools you currently use. Applications without samples or the code word will not be reviewed.



We reply to every serious applicant. Looking forward to building something great together.

title: Product Lister
description:
A-Player Product Lister Wanted — Fast-Growing US Jewelry Brand (Shopify + AI)



Position: Product Lister (Full-Time, Remote)

Company: Fast-growing US-based online jewelry brand

Schedule: Flexible, but must be quickly reachable during agreed working hours



ABOUT US



We run a fast-growing online jewelry shop selling to customers in the United States. We move fast, we use the latest AI tools in our daily workflow, and we're building a small team of true A-players. If you're average, this job is not for you. If you're exceptional at what you do and want to grow with a brand that values initiative, keep reading.



THE ROLE



You will be responsible for creating high-quality, conversion-focused product listings for our Shopify store. This is not a copy-paste job. We're looking for someone who treats product listing as a craft: sharp copy, beautiful AI-generated visuals, clean data, and a constant drive to improve how we work.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



- Create and publish polished product listings on Shopify (titles, descriptions, variants, pricing, tags, collections)

- Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to write compelling, on-brand product copy

- Generate and edit product images and short videos using AI image/video generation tools

- Continuously improve and refine our AI prompts — and proactively suggest better ones

- Keep our Google Sheets (product data, trackers, workflows) accurate and up to date

- Follow our SOPs precisely — and suggest improvements when you see a smarter way

- Communicate daily with the team via Slack

- Bring new ideas: trending products, better listing structures, tools, and workflows that help our shop grow



MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years of proven experience in product listing (Shopify preferred — please mention the stores/niches you've worked in)

- Strong Shopify knowledge — you understand how the platform works beyond just adding products (collections, variants, apps, themes basics)

- Hands-on experience with AI tools: Claude and/or ChatGPT for copywriting, plus AI image and video generation (e.g. Higgsfield, DALL·E, Runway, or similar)

- Excellent prompting skills — you know how to get great output from AI, and you improve prompts on your own initiative

- Google Sheets proficiency — comfortable with organized data, formulas, and trackers

- Experience with Slack for daily team communication

- Excellent written English — your copy sells our products

- Detail-obsessed — you catch the typo, the wrong price, the missing variant, every time

- SOP-driven — you follow processes exactly, and you document what you learn

- Proactive and innovative — you don't wait to be told; you spot opportunities and bring ideas to grow the shop

- Flexible and quickly reachable — you respond fast during working hours and can adapt when priorities shift



WHAT MAKES YOU AN A-PLAYER (NICE TO HAVE)



- Understanding of what makes a listing convert (benefit-driven copy, emotional angles, gift positioning)

- Basic photo editing skills (Canva, Photoshop, or similar)

- Familiarity with US customer psychology and seasonal trends (Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Christmas)

- Experience working with dropshipping or e-commerce teams



WHAT WE OFFER



- Long-term, stable full-time position — we invest in people who perform

- Competitive salary based on experience and skill 

- Work with the newest AI tools and grow your skills

- A direct line to the owner — your ideas are heard and implemented

- Room to grow into a bigger role as the brand scales



HOW TO APPLY



Send your application with:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your product listing experience

2. Links or screenshots of product listings you've created (Shopify preferred)

3. Which AI tools you use and 1–2 examples of prompts you're proud of

5. Your available working hours (please convert to CET)



?? Important: Start your application with the word "Yellow". Applications without this word will be ignored — this shows us you read the full job post carefully. Attention to detail starts here.



We review every serious application personally and respond quickly to candidates who stand out. If you're the A-player we're looking for, we'd love to meet you.

title: Remote Open-Source Investigative Researcher
description:
This position is ideal for someone who genuinely enjoys investigative research. If you love digging through police departments, sheriff's offices, public records, and local news to uncover fascinating real-life stories, you'll probably love this job.



About Us



We produce documentary-style YouTube videos featuring real police body-cam footage, dash-cam footage, high-speed pursuits, DUI arrests, unusual criminal behaviour, and other compelling law enforcement i
.



We are looking for a detail-oriented researcher who enjoys finding interesting stories and uncovering original source material.



Your Primary Responsibility



Your job is to locate high-quality, original-source law enforcement footage that could be turned into engaging YouTube videos.



You are not editing videos.



You are not writing scripts.



Your responsibility is to identify compelling i
, verify their original sources, and organize everything for our production team.



Think of yourself as an investigative researcher.



What We're Looking For



We want i
 that immediately grab attention and tell a complete story.



Examples include:



Vehicle I

DUI Arrests

Drunk Drivers

High-Speed Pursuits

Police Chases

PIT Maneuvers

Stolen Vehicles

Reckless Driving

Wrong-Way Drivers

Road Rage

Arrests

Shoplifting

Retail Theft

Airport Arrests

Public Intoxication

Disorderly Conduct

Drug Arrests

Burglary

Armed Suspects

Warrant Arrests

Unique Encounters

Sovereign Citizens

Fake Police Officers

Fake Lawyers

Fake Doctors

Karen Arrests

Viral Public Freakouts

Officer Use of Force

Taser Deployments

K9 Deployments

Foot Pursuits

Resisting Arrest

Barricaded Suspects

Court-Related

Sentencing

Courtroom Outbursts

Judge Confrontations



What Makes a Great Story?



Every case should have:



? A clear beginning



? Escalating conflict



? Interesting dialogue



? Strong emotional reactions



? A satisfying conclusion



Examples:



Arrest

Taser deployment

K9 apprehension

Vehicle crash

Confession

Discovery of evidence

Court sentencing



What We Do NOT Want



Do NOT submit:



? Routine traffic stops



? Calm officer interactions



? Parking complaints



? Noise complaints



? Long interviews



? Court proceedings where nothing happens



? Videos with poor audio



? Grainy footage



? Videos with no clear story



If nothing interesting happens...



We don't want it.



IMPORTANT — Original Source Footage Only



This is the most important part of the job.



We are NOT looking for videos from existing YouTube channels that have already compiled or edited police footage.



We want the original source whenever possible.



Preferred Sources



? Official Sheriff's Office YouTube Channels



? Official Police Department YouTube Channels



? Government Websites



? Official Bodycam Releases



? Official Dashcam Releases



? Court Recordings



? Public Records



? Local News Articles that identify the original law enforcement source



Do NOT Submit



? YouTube compilation channels



? Reaction videos



? Commentary channels



? TikTok reposts



? Instagram clips



?
 



? AI narrated videos



? Existing "Top 10 Arrests" videos



? Videos copied from another creator



If another YouTube creator already made a documentary about the case...



Find where THEY got the footage.



That's what we want.



Daily Responsibilities



Your daily workflow will include:



Searching official law enforcement sources

Finding newly released bodycam footage

Locating related news articles

Verifying the original source

Watching footage to determine if it contains a compelling story

Writing a short case summary

Organizing everything into our content database

Every Submission Must Include



For every case you find, you'll submit:



Case Title

Date

Agency Name

State

Original Source Link

Related News Link (if available)

Length of Raw Footage

3–5 sentence summary

Why is this case interesting

Excitement Score (1–10)



How We Evaluate Videos



Every submission is scored.



Story (1–10)



Does it tell a complete story?



Conflict (1–10)



Does something unexpected happen?



Action (1–10)



Foot pursuit?



Vehicle chase?



Taser?



K9?



Resistance?



Video Quality (1–10)



HD?



Clear audio?



Easy to watch?



Ending (1–10)



Does the story have a satisfying conclusion?



Only videos scoring 40/50 or higher will be approved.



Skills We're Looking For



Excellent online research skills

Strong attention to detail

Ability to identify engaging stories

Organized and dependable

Fluent in written English

Experience with Google Sheets is a plus

Familiarity with U.S. law enforcement is a bonus, but not required



Trial Project (Paid)



Before hiring, you'll complete a paid research assignment.



Find 10 original-source law enforcement cases that meet our criteria.



For each case include:



Original source

Case summary

Why it would make a great YouTube story

Excitement score

Supporting news article (if available)



This helps us evaluate your research skills and attention to detail.



Compensation



Hourly position

Initial commitment: 15–20 hours per week during the first month to build our content library

Ongoing commitment: 5–10 hours per week

Long-term opportunity for the right candidate

Compensation

 with the subject line "Concept Senior – [Your Name] – Night Shift" so we know you read this post.
